Namun Gizmo friends bisa mendapatkannya dengan harga promo mulai Rp9,249 juta saja dengan syarat dan ketentuan yang berlaku.
Sejumlah benefit tambahan ditawarkan untuk para konsumen, mulai dari bank cashback hingga Rp750 ribu, trade-in cashback sampai Rp500 ribu, serta diskon tambahan dari Samsung Reservation+ senilai hingga Rp500 ribu. Plus, gratis berlangganan Google AI Pro dan cloud storage 5TB senilai Rp1,8 juta.

The Islamabad High Court (IHC), hearing a case against the PTI’s September 27 protest, on Saturday sought affidavits from the Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa chief secretary and inspector general of police after the former assured the court that government machinery or resources would not be used for any political gathering.

Read: Tariq Fazal warns PTI of ‘other options’ if Sept 27 march goes ahead
A two-page written order was issued by the bench comprising Chief Justice Sarfraz Dogar, Justice Azam Khan and Justice Muhammad Asif.
According to the order, the advocates general of K-P, Punjab, Sindh and Balochistan had completed their arguments. The court noted that the KP secretary had given an undertaking that government machinery or resources would not be used for any political gathering.
The court subsequently directed the K-P chief secretary and inspector general of police to submit affidavits to this effect at the next hearing.
The case will be heard on Monday at 10am. 
The court clarified that the chief secretaries and inspectors general of police of the provinces were not required to appear in person.

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
BRICS leaders on Saturday called for greater efforts to prevent and peacefully resolve conflicts amid the wars in Iran and Ukraine, while opposing any forced displacement of Palestinians from the Gaza Strip.
The calls were included in the New Delhi Declaration, unanimously adopted on the first day of the bloc's two-day summit in the Indian capital.
Expressing "deep concern" over continued violence in Gaza despite the October 2025 ceasefire agreement, BRICS leaders called for an end to "any policies aimed at forced displacement of Palestinians from the Gaza Strip".
The declaration also expressed "concern regarding arrangements that may prejudice the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and legitimise or prolong occupation".
"We reaffirm that a just and lasting solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict can only be achieved by peaceful means and depends on the fulfilment of the legitimate rights of the Palestinian people, including the rights to self-determination and return," it said.
The bloc also rejected "any unilateral measures that seek to alter the legal and historical status of occupied Jerusalem".
"We urge full respect for the sanctity of all religious sites and holy places in the city and for the rights of all to access and to observe their religious rites without hindrance," the New Delhi Declaration said on Saturday.
The bloc also condemned attacks on the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) installations and personnel, emphasising that "such attacks are a violation of international law".
Noting the "current global context of polarisation and distrust", BRICS members called on the international community to respond to challenges and related security threats through "politico-diplomatic measures to lower conflict potential".
The bloc also stressed the "need to engage in conflict prevention efforts, including through addressing their root causes".
"We encourage the active role of regional organizations in conflict prevention and resolution and support all efforts conducive to the peaceful settlement of crises," the declaration said.
BRICS leaders also expressed concern over the growing risks of nuclear conflict and called for disarmament, arms control and nonproliferation.
The declaration voiced "serious concern" over "deliberate attacks" on civilian infrastructure and peaceful nuclear facilities.
"Nuclear safeguards, safety, and security must always be upheld, including in armed conflicts, to protect people and the environment from harm," it said.
Condemn unilateral trade measures
The BRICS leaders noted that the multilateral trading system "has long been at a crossroads".
"The proliferation of trade-restrictive actions that are inconsistent with World Trade Organisation (WTO) rules, whether in the form of indiscriminate rising of tariffs and non-tariff measures," the statement said.
"We voice serious concerns about the rise of unilateral tariff and non-tariff measures which distort trade and are inconsistent with WTO rules," it added.
The BRICS bloc condemned the imposition of unilateral coercive measures that "are contrary to international law, and reiterate that such measures, inter alia in the form of unilateral economic sanctions and secondary sanctions, have far-reaching negative implications for human rights, including the rights to development, health and food security, of the general population of targeted states, disproportionately affecting the poor and people in vulnerable situations, deepening the digital divide and exacerbating environmental challenges".
Xi urges BRICS peace role in Middle East
Chinese President Xi Jinping urged the BRICS bloc to be a peacemaker in the Middle East conflict, in ​an address to a summit of member countries in New Delhi.
China will work with other BRICS members in that role, as the war "does not serve the common interests of the international community", state-run CCTV quoted Xi as saying.
BRICS, originally comprising ​Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa and expanded to include Egypt, Ethiopia, ​Indonesia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates, was set up in 2009 ⁠to challenge a world order dominated by the United States and its ​Western allies.
Its members account for more than 40% of the world's population and ​almost a quarter of the global economy.
The Chinese leader called the bloc a "leading group" in the Global South and a model of self-reliance among emerging and developing countries that should ​promote innovation-driven development.
He said China would assume the BRICS chairmanship next year and ​host the 19th BRICS summit, according to CCTV.
In a meeting with Indian Prime Minister Narendra ‌Modi ⁠on the sidelines of the summit, Xi said China views ties with India from a "strategic, long-term perspective", state-run Xinhua News Agency reported.
China and India can learn from each other's strengths and achieve shared development, Xinhua quoted Xi as saying.
Xi's ​visit to New Delhi, ​his first to ⁠India in seven years, should further the diplomatic thaw between the giant neighbours, but there are few signs as ​yet that their business ties will improve, analysts said.
China and India ​fought a ⁠brief war in 1962, setting the backdrop for a wary relationship since then, which soured after a 2020 border skirmish killed 20 Indian and four Chinese soldiers. ⁠Still, ​ties have improved in recent years, especially since ​Modi visited China last year and as both nations grapple with volatile relationships with the US.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
WhatsApp is rolling out a new feature that allows users to watch video status updates at 2x speed. The feature is currently being tested with some WhatsApp beta users on iOS and could make it easier to quickly go through multiple status updates.
WhatsApp Rolling Out 2x Video Playback for Status Updates
According to WABetaInfo, the feature is available with WhatsApp beta for iOS 26.36.10.70 through TestFlight. WhatsApp is gradually expanding access to more beta testers, so it may not be available to everyone yet.
How to Watch WhatsApp Status at 2x Speed
The new feature does not require users to open any settings or enable a playback option manually. Instead, WhatsApp uses a simple gesture.
Users need to open a video status and press and hold the right side of the screen. WhatsApp will immediately increase the playback speed to 2x while the finger remains on the screen.
As soon as the user releases the screen, the video returns to its normal playback speed. This also allows users to switch between normal and 2x playback whenever they want while watching a status.
Useful for Longer Status Videos
The new playback option could be particularly useful as WhatsApp recently increased the maximum length of music clips in status updates.
Previously, users could add music clips of up to 15 seconds to a status. A recent update increased the limit to 30 seconds, giving users more flexibility when creating status updates.
However, longer status videos can also take more time to watch, especially for people who regularly view a large number of updates. The 2x playback feature gives users a quick way to get through these videos without skipping them completely.
The feature is not limited to status videos with music. It can be used with any video shared through WhatsApp Status.
Familiar Gesture for Users
The press-and-hold gesture may feel familiar to users of other popular video platforms. Services such as Instagram, TikTok and YouTube already offer similar ways to temporarily increase video playback speed.
WhatsApp is bringing a similar experience to its Status section. Since the feature only works while users hold their finger on the screen, they do not need to learn or manage any additional controls.
Currently Limited to iOS Beta Testers
WhatsApp is currently making the 2x status playback feature available to some users running iOS beta version 26.36.10.70.
The feature is still in the testing phase, and WhatsApp has not confirmed when it will reach all users. The company is expected to expand availability.
The post WhatsApp Rolling Out 2x Video Playback for Status Updates appeared first on PhoneWorld.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
OPPO has started teasing its upcoming Find X10 series in China. The company has confirmed several key details about the OPPO Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max ahead of their official launch later this month.
The Find X10 Pro Max will stand out with a powerful camera setup featuring three 200-megapixel cameras. OPPO says all three cameras will support 8K video recording, making the phone a strong option for users who want advanced photography and video features.
OPPO Find X10 Pro Max Confirmed to Feature Three 200MP Cameras
The Find X10 Pro Max will feature three 200MP sensors, covering different photography needs. The main camera will offer up to 17 stops of dynamic range and will include OPPO’s DeepPix technology.
All three cameras will also be capable of recording videos in 8K resolution. This could give users more flexibility when switching between cameras while recording high-resolution videos.
OpenGate Capture Support
OPPO has also confirmed OpenGate capture for the Find X10 Pro Max. This feature allows the phone to use the full area of its image sensor when taking photos or recording videos.
Users can then crop the footage during post-production without being limited to a standard frame. OPPO is also adding integration with the Blackmagic Camera app, allowing users to access features such as O-Log2 and OpenGate directly through the app.
8,000mAh Battery and ColorOS 17
Both the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max will come with an 8,000mAh silicon-carbon battery. The phones will run Android 17-based ColorOS 17 out of the box.
OPPO has also confirmed a new Tianma OLED display for the series. The panel can reduce its brightness to as low as 1 nit, which should make the screen more comfortable to use in dark environments.
OPPO Find X10 Specifications
The standard Find X10 will also receive a high-end camera setup. It will feature two 200-megapixel cameras along with a second-generation Danxia color sensor.
The additional color sensor should help improve color accuracy. OPPO says the Find X10 can achieve up to 15 stops of dynamic range.
The phone will also feature extremely slim bezels measuring just 0.99mm, giving it a more immersive display design.
Find X10 Series Launch
OPPO will launch the Find X10 series in China this September. The company is gradually revealing more specifications ahead of the official launch, with the Find X10 Pro Max expected to be the most advanced model in the lineup.

items.content:
Apple akhirnya resmi masuk ke pasar smartphone layar lipat atau foldable lewat iPhone Duo. Dibandingkan Samsung, Google, Huawei, dan produsen Android lainnya, kehadiran iPhone lipat pertama Apple ini memang terbilang terlambat.
Namun dari sudut pandang perusahaan berbasis di Cupertino tersebut, persoalannya lebih dari sekadar menjadi paling pertama. 
Baca Juga: Sony Lepas Physint Hideo Kojima, Apa yang Terjadi?
Dalam wawancara bersama Tom’s Guide, CEO Apple John Ternus dan Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing Greg Joswiak mengungkap beberapa hal penting sebelum perusahaan adopsi foldable ke iPhone.
Baik dari rasa permukaan layar saat disentuh, kontinuitas antarmuka ketika perangkat dibuka dan ditutup, hingga kesiapan aplikasi pihak ketiga untuk mengoptimalkan layar iPhone yang lebih besar.
“Apple menunggu sampai memiliki ide produk yang memenuhi standar perusahaan dalam kualitas, durabilitas, dan desain,” kata John Ternus, sebagaimana dikutip dari Tom;s Guide, Sabtu (12/9/2026).
Nano-texture Jadi Titik Penting iPhone Duo
Salah satu momen bagi Ternus muncul ketika ia melihat teknologi nano-texture diterapkan pada prototipe iPhone Duo. “Rasanya sepert, ‘ya, itu dia’,” ujar bos baru Apple tersebut ketika menjelaskan reaksinya saat melihat teknologi itu terpasang di prototipe foldable Apple.
Setelah arahnya tepat, tantangan berikutnya adalah bagaimana membuat teknologi itu benar-benar diproduksi. Sebetulnya, nano-texture bukan teknologi benar-benar baru bagi Apple.
Permbuat iPhone itu sudah menggunakan teknologi tersebut pada beberapa perangkat lainnya, tetapi iPhone Duo butuh pendekatan berbeda karena layar fleksibelnya menggunakan permukaan polimer.
Menurut Apple, lapisan nano-texture membantu mengurangi pantulan sekaligus meminimalkan visibilitas bekas lipatan pada layar bagian dalam. Layar dalam iPhone Duo berukuran 7,6 inci, sementara bagian luar menggunakan layar 5,4 inci. Keduanya memiliki rasio aspek yang sama agar konten bisa berpindah secara proporsional ketika perangkat dibuka atau ditutup.
Apple Tak Mau iPhone Lipat Setengah Matang
Namun layar bukan satu-satunya pertimbangan Apple. Greg Joswiak cukup terbuka ketika membahas apa yang sudah dilakukan produsen lain di kategori foldable.
“Apa yang kami lihat dilakukan orang lain tidak terlalu menginspirasi,” ujar Joswiak. Ia menambahkan, Apple tidak ingin terburu-buru masuk ke sebuah kategori dengan sesuatu yang belum matang benar.
Pernyataan tersebut tentu merupakan pandangan Apple terhadap produk kompetitor, bukan berarti seluruh persoalan foldable Android belum terselesaikan. Bahkan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, produsen Android telah membuat kemajuan besar dalam desain yang semakin tipis, ringan, serta matang dari sisi hardware.
Namun komentar Joswiak memberi gambaran mengenai area yang ingin dijadikan pembeda Apple pada iPhone Duo: integrasi antara hardware, sistem operasi, dan aplikasi.
iOS 27 secara khusus disesuaikan untuk form factor tersebut. Apple memindahkan sejumlah elemen navigasi dan kontrol ke sisi layar agar mudah dijangkau baik ketika perangkat tertutup maupun terbuka.
Ternus mencontohkan bagaimana posisi kontrol tetap berada di bawah ibu jari kanan, dan ketika pengguna berpindah dari layar luar ke layar dalam. Intinya, Apple ingin penggunaan dua layar terasa sebagai satu pengalaman yang berkelanjutan, bukan dua antarmuka berbeda yang harus dipelajari ulang.
iOS 27 juga menghadirkan Split View untuk membuka dua aplikasi secara berdampingan, kemampuan menjalankan dua jendela dari aplikasi yang sama seperti Safari, sampai menyimpan pasangan aplikasi untuk digunakan kembali.
iPhone Duo Akan Hadir di Indonesia
Apple membanderol iPhone Duo mulai USD 1.999 di Amerika Serikat untuk varian penyimpanan 256GB. Perangkat ini tersedia dalam warna star white dan night sky, dengan kapasitas hingga 2TB. Pre-order global dimulai 16 Oktober 2026 dan penjualan di sejumlah pasar berlangsung mulai 23 Oktober.
Sementara itu, Apple Indonesia sudah memastikan iPhone Duo akan segera tersedia di Tanah Air. Namun hingga saat ini perusahaan belum mengumumkan harga maupun tanggal penjualan resminya untuk pasar Indonesia.
Pada akhirnya, klaim Apple perusahaan menunggu hingga pengalaman foldable cukup matang masih perlu dibuktikan setelah iPhone Duo digunakan lebih luas.
Nano-texture menawarkan pendekatan berbeda terhadap salah satu kompromi layar fleksibel, sementara iOS 27 dirancang agar perpindahan antara dua layar terasa konsisten. Tetapi pembeda yang lebih sulit direplikasi mungkin justru berada pada ekosistem aplikasinya.
Jika dukungan developer bisa mengikuti ambisi Apple, datang terlambat ke kategori foldable mungkin tidak menjadi masalah besar. Jika tidak, iPhone Duo tetap harus menghadapi pertanyaan yang sama seperti foldable lain: seberapa banyak layar besar tersebut benar-benar mengubah cara pengguna memakai smartphone sehari-hari?

items.content:
Eternal’s food delivery arm Zomato has begun charging an additional ‘Pay on delivery’ fee on some cash-on-delivery (COD) orders, with the charge varying across transactions.
Inc42 reviewed multiple orders on which Zomato levied the new fee. In two of these orders, Zomato levied pay-on-delivery fees of ₹5 and ₹13, respectively. The charge was displayed separately from the platform fee, delivery partner fee, restaurant packaging charges, and taxes.
Separately, a Zomato user took to X to flag a ₹21 charge for choosing COD.
Screengrab of a customer’s post on X flagging the fee hike by the food delivery platform.
 
The variation indicates that the fee is not fixed. However, it remains unclear if the amount is determined by the order value, location, restaurant, customer profile, or other factors.
Zomato also displays a message encouraging customers to pay online to avoid the additional charge.
It is not clear when the levy was introduced, whether it has been rolled out nationally, or the rationale behind its pricing structure. However, Inc42 has seen the fee on orders placed earlier this month.
Inc42 has reached out to Zomato for details about the rollout, fee structure, and rationale behind the charge. The story will be updated upon receiving a response.
Another Monetisation Push
The new charge comes as Zomato continues to increase customer-facing fees to improve monetisation from its food delivery business.
In March, the company raised its platform fee by nearly 20% to ₹14.90 per order from ₹12.50 earlier. The revised fee was being levied on a pre-GST basis, with the hike implemented pan-India.
Zomato’s rival Swiggy subsequently increased its platform fee by more than 17% to ₹17.58 per order from ₹14.99. The company said the revised levy would help it operate and maintain its platform.
Unlike the platform fee, which applies irrespective of the mode of payment, Zomato’s new levy is linked to a customer’s decision to pay at the time of delivery. It makes COD orders more expensive while the company explicitly encourages customers to switch to online payments to avoid the charge.
The move comes at a time when competition in India’s food delivery market is widening beyond Zomato and Swiggy.
Flipkart is piloting its food delivery service Eat In in Bengaluru, beginning with internal employee testing. The ecommerce major reportedly plans to charge restaurants a commission of 10%–11% per order, potentially undercutting the commission rates charged by incumbents.
Rapido has also expanded its food delivery play with Ownly, which it formally launched in March 2026 after testing the service in parts of Bengaluru. Meanwhile, quick food delivery startup Swish raised $24 Mn earlier this week in a funding round led by Bertelsmann India Investments to expand its kitchen network and enter new cities.
In a separate development, Zomato recently laid off around 240 employees as it shut down its customer support operations in Hyderabad.
The company is also experimenting with rapid food delivery through vending machines called “Zomato Now”, which have reportedly been installed at corporate offices in Gurugram in partnership with restaurants.
On the financial front, Eternal reported a consolidated net profit of ₹92 Cr in the first quarter of FY27, up nearly 3.7X from ₹25 Cr in the year-ago quarter. Its operating revenue surged 182% YoY to ₹20,211 Cr during the quarter.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
The National Payments Corporation of India’s (NPCI’s) consolidated net profit fell 32.4% to ₹989.4 Cr in the financial year ended March 2026 from ₹1,463.2 Cr in FY25, as a sharp rise in tax expenses offset growth in its pre-tax profit.
The payments infrastructure operator’s revenue from operations grew 21.8% to ₹4,240 Cr in FY26 from ₹3,480.8 Cr in the previous fiscal year, according to its annual report.
Including other income of ₹632.6 Cr, total income rose 20% YoY to ₹4,872.6 Cr in FY26.
Income from payment services, NPCI’s biggest revenue stream, increased 16.3% to ₹3,735.8 Cr during the year under review from ₹3,212 Cr in FY25. The segment accounted for 88.1% of the revenue from operations in FY26.
The UPI operator’s other revenue streams include network income, implementation services, certification income, fetching fees, among others.
NPCI’s profit before tax grew 5.4% to ₹1,888 Cr from ₹1,791.8 Cr. However, its tax expense surged 173.4% to ₹898.5 Cr from ₹328.7 Cr, pulling down its net profit. Current tax rose 19% YoY to ₹568 Cr, while deferred tax expense stood at ₹330.7 Cr compared with a deferred tax credit of ₹11.1 Cr in FY25. The previous year’s tax expense had also benefited from a prior-year tax adjustment of ₹137.6 Cr.
It is pertinent to note that as NPCI is incorporated as a not-for-profit company under Section 8 of the Companies Act, its financial statements use “surplus” instead of profit and report profit after tax as “surplus for the period”.
Where Did NPCI Spend In FY26?
NPCI’s total expenses increased 31.5% to ₹2,984.6 Cr in FY26 from ₹2,269.8 Cr in the previous year.
Marketing: This remained NPCI’s biggest cost head, accounting for nearly 48% of its total expenses. Marketing expenses rose 27.3% to ₹1,420.3 Cr from ₹1,116 Cr in FY25.
Within this, marketing and branding expenses increased 10.2% YoY to ₹770.3 Cr, while product incentives and cashback expenses jumped 55.8% to ₹650 Cr.
NPCI said these expenses included payments to banks for RuPay cards, cashback campaigns to promote digital transactions, RuPay media and advertising campaigns, business-to-business initiatives, and sponsorships.
Employee Benefit Expenses: This cost head rose 22.6% to ₹534.4 Cr from ₹435.8 Cr in the previous year.
NPCI reclassified outsourcing costs from employee benefit expenses to administrative and other expenses from April 1, 2025. In FY26, it booked ₹54 Cr in outsourcing costs under administrative expenses, compared with ₹31.6 Cr included under employee expenses in FY25.
Consequently, administrative and other expenses rose 54.4% to ₹293.4 Cr in FY26 from ₹190 Cr in the previous year.
Operating Expenses: NPCI’s operating expenses grew 38.6% to ₹291.4 Cr from ₹210.3 Cr in FY25. These included annual maintenance charges on network and IT equipment, network costs, testing and certification charges, and data centre expenses.
Notably, data centre rental expenses jumped nearly 20X to ₹10.4 Cr from ₹52.5 Lakh, while data centre power and fuel costs increased 51.5% YoY to ₹33 Cr.
BHIM’s Loss Widens
Loss of NPCI BHIM Services Ltd (NBSL), the wholly owned subsidiary that operates the BHIM app, widened nearly sixfold to ₹390.6 Cr in FY26 from ₹68.1 Cr in FY25.
NBSL generated a turnover of ₹27.8 Cr during the year and reported a loss before tax of ₹372.6 Cr.
The subsidiary was incorporated in June 2024 as a for-profit entity to drive the growth and expansion of BHIM. NPCI transferred its BHIM strategic business unit to NBSL with effect from October 1, 2024.
In comparison, NPCI Bharat BillPay Ltd’s net profit grew 33.6% to ₹31.5 Cr from ₹23.6 Cr on a turnover of ₹161.1 Cr.
NPCI International Payments Ltd, which is responsible for taking UPI and RuPay to overseas markets, reported a loss of ₹19.4 Cr, nearly double the ₹10 Cr loss recorded in FY25. Its turnover stood at ₹83 Cr.
The financial performance comes as UPI continues to scale to new highs. The payments system processed a record 24.51 Bn transactions worth ₹29.82 Lakh Cr in August 2026.
Meanwhile, NPCI continued to expand its digital payments ecosystem at the Global Fintech Fest 2026 this week, unveiling agentic AI platforms and open-source Android ATMs capable of instantly issuing RuPay cards and generating merchant UPI QR codes.
The post NPCI’s FY26 Profit Drops 32% YoY To ₹989 Cr As Tax Outgo, BHIM Loss Surge appeared first on Inc42 Media.

items.author: Ayesha Saghir
items.content:
Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah on Saturday said the debate over the creation of new provinces should take place in Parliament and a referendum could be held with the approval of the legislature.
Speaking at a press conference in Lahore, Sanaullah said, “The decision of whether any province will be created or not will be made in Parliament, and by Parliament,” adding that if a referendum were to be conducted to seek public opinion, it would also require approval by the National Assembly (NA) under Article 48 clause six of the Constitution of Pakistan.
Article 48(6) of the Constitution provides that if the prime minister considers it necessary to hold a referendum on any matter of national importance, he may refer the matter to a joint sitting of Parliament.
Two days earlier, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Dr Tariq Fazal Chaudhry had said that the debate on forming new provinces would be held in the next session of the NA and the Senate in October. The debate was sparked across the country after Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi said the administrative system had collapsed and there was a need for the creation of new units. The suggestion has resulted in widespread opposition from different parts of the country.
“The outcome will also emerge in Parliament,” PM's Adviser Sanaullah emphasised.
He opined that the matter could be resolved in a proper manner if all the political parties and provincial leaders deliberated on it.
Sanaullah also revealed that intra-party discussions were underway to determine PML-N’s unified stance on the formation of new provinces.
He said the PML-N would participate in the debate when the issue was brought up for discussion in Parliament and that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif would also express his views on the floor.
Sanaullah said that statements and speeches on the issue through different forums had not helped improve the situation and that the matter should be taken to the lower house for deliberation. He also stated that the matter was not fit for discussion on an economic forum.
“When this debate comes to Parliament, all parties will be able to present their positions,” he added.
He said that if he himself declared that provinces would or would not be created, he would be bypassing Parliament.
Sanaullah said the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) had “overreacted” to the issue by passing a resolution against division of Sindh, adding that no federal minister had so far even raised the matter in the cabinet or Parliament.
Read: Referendum to decide creation of new provinces
Speaking about the strain in ties between the PPP and PML-N, Sanaullah said the bitterness between the parties developed during the Azad Jammu and Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan elections had considerably decreased.
He said a recent bi-party meeting was attended by senior leadership from the PPP and PML-N at the Punjab Governor House today.
“An understanding has been reached between the two parties.”
He suggested that such meetings should ideally be held every month, and that the latest meeting had taken place after a gap of two to three months due to elections.
When probed about his views on Jamaat-e-Islami’s protest over petrol prices, Sanaullah said, “The prime minister wants petrol prices to decrease more than JI does.”
However, he noted that sit-ins and long marches are within constitutional and legal bounds and hoped the political activities would remain peaceful.
“They (JI) have never been violent during their political activities.”
He revealed that the government had requested the party to postpone the protest for “two weeks” during a meeting that took place yesterday.
Sanaullah urged JI not to put itself in a difficult spot.
Read more: Debate on new provinces to be held in next session of National Assembly, Senate in October: Tariq Fazal
“The government is considering ways to offer relief to the public in the form of subsidies or other methods,” he said during the presser.
Reiterating the explanation given by Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik regarding escalating petrol prices, Sanaullah said the increase in prices of petroleum products was a consequence of the US-Iran war. He said the country has pushed for a diplomatic resolution of the conflict.
Referring to statements given by certain elements in the PTI about going to Islamabad and bringing down the system, he said there were also reports that some people attending the gathering could be armed. He said people involved in terrorist activities in Balochistan and Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa also intended to take advantage of the unrest.
“Those whose intentions are not peaceful must be stopped by law-enforcement agencies.”
Speaking on intra-party matters, Sanaullah said a meeting of the Punjab PML-N wing had been called today during which inactive office-bearers would be replaced and vacant positions filled.
He said the process would be completed within the next 30 days.
Sanaullah also revealed that the Punjab government was planning to conduct local government elections.
Division or devolution of power?
“The system we are living under has collapsed.”
With these words, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi reopened one of Pakistan’s most politically sensitive debates: whether the country’s governance structure has become too centralised, too unwieldy and too distant from the people it is supposed to serve. Speaking at the Pakistan Economic Summit in Islamabad towards the end of July, Naqvi argued that Pakistan’s existing administrative model had failed to deliver basic services, timely justice and meaningful economic opportunities, and called for a serious discussion on creating new administrative units or provinces.
Naqvi’s argument is not simply about drawing new lines on a map. At its core is the question of whether a country of Pakistan’s size and population can continue to be governed through a structure in which political, administrative and financial power remains concentrated in a handful of provincial capitals. He contended that decentralisation could bring decision-making closer to citizens, improve service delivery and create space for new leadership.
A week ago, Naqvi proposed to take the debate over new provinces or administrative units directly to the public. He said that the government had failed to deliver basic amenities to the public, including education, potable water, healthcare and other services. Therefore, he asked the stakeholders to decide on the issue while remaining within the constitutional framework.
The Sindh Assembly, however, rejected the proposal to divide the province and reaffirmed its opposition to any such alteration in Sindh’s territorial limits. The resolution passed by it argued that any restructuring of the federation must respect constitutional procedures, democratic consent and the will of the people of the province.
Also Read: ‘Sindh is one, shall remain one’: Assembly passes resolution against division of province
The resistance illustrates why the provinces question is considerably more complicated than an administrative exercise.
MQM's Mustafa Kamal, who leads the health ministry at the centre, has avidly shown his interest in carving out provinces from Sindh. Before Naqvi's speech, Kamal had floated the idea of Sindh's division, which was met with strong opposition. He remains one of the greatest flag-bearers of the movement.
On September 7, PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan, whose party governs K-P, also cautioned that an attempt to divide Sindh and other provinces without the consent of the people would weaken the federation and urged political entities to avoid taking decisions on new provinces' creation in haste.
Yet creating new provinces would itself require a demanding constitutional process. Legal experts cited by The Express Tribune have pointed out that a public vote alone cannot create a new province. Any change affecting provincial boundaries must comply with the constitutional amendment procedure, including the required approval of the relevant provincial assembly. A referendum could potentially provide democratic legitimacy, but it would not replace the constitutional mechanism.
The debate, therefore, is ultimately about more than the number of provinces Pakistan should have. It is about how power should be distributed between the federation, provinces and local governments — and whether citizens should have greater control over the institutions responsible for delivering services to them.
In view of the constant back-and-forth between political parties on the issue at different forums, two days ago, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Dr Tariq Fazal Chaudhry said that deliberations on forming new provinces would be conducted in the next session of the Parliament and the Senate in October.

items.title: Yemeni government forces thwart major Houthi attack in oil-rich Marib: Media
items.summary:
Yemeni government forces thwarted a large-scale attack by the Houthi group in the oil-rich Marib province in central Yemen on Saturday, according to local media.
The government-aligned West Coast news website said government forces repelled the attack in the Al-Mashjah and Al-Zour areas, west of Marib.

items.content:
Yemeni government forces thwarted a large-scale attack by the Houthi group in the oil-rich Marib province in central Yemen on Saturday, according to local media.
The government-aligned West Coast news website said government forces repelled the attack in the Al-Mashjah and Al-Zour areas, west of Marib.
The website provided no further details, while neither government forces nor the Houthis issued an immediate statement on the report.
The development comes amid ongoing fighting between government forces and the Houthis across several fronts, including Marib, Al-Jawf, Taiz, Al-Dhale and Al-Bayda provinces.
Read: Trump says Iran probably responsible for attack on Saudi pipeline
Social media activists circulated videos purportedly showing dozens of Houthi members who were killed or captured during fighting Friday on several fronts along Marib’s borders.
Yesterday, the Trump administration had no plans for direct military action against Houthi forces in Yemen, though it is providing Saudi Arabia with substantial intelligence and targeting support, two US officials told ABC News on Friday.
The anonymous officials said that assessment could shift if threats to Red Sea shipping routes intensify, they noted.
Admiral Brad Cooper, head of the US military’s Central Command, visited Saudi Arabia for talks Thursday as part of Washington's support for Riyadh, said one official.
Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman held two calls on Thursday with President Donald Trump, with the prince pressing for direct US military involvement, though he stopped short of calling it essential, according to the official.
"The United States is focused on protecting our core national security interests – such as ensuring freedom of navigation in the Red Sea – while empowering our regional partners to take the lead in managing and resolving regional security challenges," said a senior administration official.
Read more: What is Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, and what its 'precautionary' shutdown means?
A second official said Riyadh had signalled a willingness to launch a major offensive against the Houthis alone if necessary, though no decision had been made.
Officials added that Houthi forces reportedly seized Yemen's west coast early Friday, but government troops and allied militias continued resisting, leaving the outcome uncertain absent outside intervention.
Yemen has been engulfed in conflict since the Houthis seized the capital Sanaa and several provinces in 2014. A Saudi-led coalition intervened in 2015 in support of Yemen’s internationally recognised government.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Central Development Working Party (CDWP) has cleared seven projects costing Rs116 billion under the government’s Uraan Pakistan initiative, including the Rs37.19 billion PakSat-2 Satellite System recommended for ECNEC consideration and the Rs3.62 billion Geo-AI Development & Innovation Hub approved by the forum aimed at strengthening the country’s space and digital capabilities.
CDWP met on Friday under the chairmanship of the Federal Minister for Planning, Development & Special Initiatives and Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission, Ahsan Iqbal. The meeting reviewed and considered a range of development initiatives aimed at strengthening key sectors of the national economy and accelerating the government’s reform agenda.
During the meeting, the forum considered and approved seven development projects. Of these, five projects, worth Rs. 21.590 billion,* were approved by the CDWP, while two major projects, with a cumulative worth of Rs. 94.301 billion, were recommended to the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) for further consideration.
CDWP Clears Seven Projects Worth Rs116 Billion Under Uraan Pakistan Initiative
The meeting was attended by the Secretary Planning, Chief Economist, VC PIDE, Members of the Planning Commission, Federal Secretaries, heads of Provincial Planning & Development Board Departments, and senior representatives from relevant federal ministries and provincial governments.
Two projects related to the Information Technology sector were presented before the forum. The project titled “ PakSat-2 Satellite System”, worth Rs. 37,192.282 million, was recommended to the ECNEC for further consideration. Another project, “ Development of GEOSPATIALx COMPLEx (Geo-AI Development & Innovation Hub)”, costing Rs. 3,623.040 million, was approved by the forum. The Minister said that development of Pakistan’s space programme was an important pillar of URAAN Pakistan.
The agenda included projects from critical sectors including Food & Agriculture, Governance, Higher Education, Information Technology, Sports, and Water. These projects are aligned with the government’s broader development vision and reform agenda under URAAN Pakistan, which focuses on strengthening human capital, modernizing governance, improving infrastructure, and promoting sustainable and inclusive economic growth.
See Also; Karachi Adds 189 New 5G Sites as Network Rollout Accelerates
A revised Food and Agriculture sector project titled “ Promotion of olive cultivation on commercial scale in Pakistan Phase-II”, worth Rs. 5014.919 million, was approved by the forum. While reviewing the project, Deputy Chairman Planning Commission Ahsan Iqbal recalled that the initiative was originally launched in 2014 under Vision 2025 and emphasized that the project should have been managed through a professional and result-oriented approach with greater private-sector participation. He said that several private-sector players had already developed successful olive cultivation practices and could play an important role in expanding the sector.
He directed that their expertise and experience should be incorporated into the project to accelerate commercial-scale olive production. Additionally, he said the Kallar Kahar-Islamabad and wider Potohar belt has strong potential for olive cultivation and directed that the region’s potential be adequately incorporated into the project. The project envisages expanding olive farms in Balochistan and NMDs. The minister emphasised that olive plantations must be targeted at one million acres.
A project of the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) titled “ Transforming and Digitalizing Revenue Administration (TADRA) Project”, worth Rs. 57,109 million, was recommended to the ECNEC for further consideration. The project is proposed to be financed through foreign funding under ADB technical assistance through a soft-term loan. While reviewing the project, Deputy Chairman Planning Commission Ahsan Iqbal stressed the need for clearly defined and measurable outcomes, particularly in terms of revenue generation, tax-to-GDP improvement, and expansion of the taxpayer base. FBR assured the forum that the investment would contribute to increasing the tax-to-GDP ratio to 13.5% by 2029 and bringing more taxpayers into the tax net. The DCPC recommended the project to ECNEC with the condition that PIDE thoroughly review its business model.
See Also: NBP Digitizes Passport Fee Payments Through Raast P2M QR
Revised Project of the Higher Education Commission (HEC) titled Establishment of DR. ASHFAQ AHMAD KHAN Center in Basic Sciences”, earlier approved in March 2018, was approved by the forum. It was part of eight National Centres of Technology but could not be completed due to land-related issues. He termed the delay unfortunate, noting that out of the eight National Centres approved in 2018, seven centres of Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Big Data and Cloud Computing, GIS and Satellite Technology, Automation and Robotics, Applied Mathematics and Livestock and Genomics were completed while this project remained pending.*
Minister constituted a committee under the Member Infrastructure and Member Science & Technology to update the centre with new emerging fields, as eight years have passed and rationalise the cost of the project. He further directed HEC to identify suitable universities in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh and Balochistan for establishing similar centres, one in each province. He said universities have to become engines of innovation and develop strong ecosystems for innovation and commercialisation of research.
Moreover, he also directed HEC to implement upgradation of laboratories at the country’s five engineering universities. UET must become a global brand for producing top-quality engineers.
A project of the Ministry of Inter-Provincial Coordination titled “ Revamping and Refurbishment of Different Facilities at Pakistan Sports Complex (PSC), Islamabad”, worth Rs. 5,758.333 million, was approved by the forum. The scope of the project includes civil and external development works, revamping and refurbishment of existing facilities, establishment of the SA Games Secretariat, upgradation of electrical works, rehabilitation of the HVAC system, plumbing and firefighting systems, and installation of security and surveillance systems.
See Also: Pakistan Clears Rs 40.8 Billion PakSat-2 and Geo-AI Projects Under Uraan Pakistan
While reviewing the project, Ahsan Iqbal directed that the summary be submitted to the Prime Minister for in-principle approval. He expressed concern over the implementation capacity of the Sports Board and stressed that the executing agency must have the institutional capacity to deliver the project effectively. Recalling previous difficulties faced due to shortcomings in the Sports Board’s performance, he emphasized that clear and single-point responsibility should be assigned for execution and accountability, rather than creating overlapping responsibilities among multiple institutions.
A project related to the Water sector titled “ Improvement of High Frequency (HF) Radios Network of Water Resources Management Directorate (WRMD), WAPDA”, worth Rs. 338.179 million, was approved by the forum. The project is proposed to be financed through foreign loan and PSDP funding.
While reviewing the project, Ahsan Iqbal emphasized the importance of strengthening communication systems for effective water resources management and ensuring that the proposed investment delivers tangible operational improvements. He directed the concerned authorities to ensure timely implementation and effective utilization of the project’s resources.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Anthropic baru saja membongkar sejumlah kasus penyalahgunaan Claude, di mana chatbot tersebut dipakai pelaku kejahatan untuk operasi siber, pengawasan negara, penipuan online, hingga riset biologis berbahaya.
Informasi ini diungkap langsung oleh perusahaan lewat laporan Threat Intelligence Report yang terbit 10 September 2026. Laporan ini merangkum temuan tim keamanan Anthropic sepanjang Desember 2025 hingga Agustus 2026.
Kasus-kasus di dalam laporan ini bukan potret penyalahgunaan Claude secara umum, melainkan beberapa pilihan insiden paling serius yang berhasil dideteksi tim keamanan perusahaan, sebagaimana dikutip dari keterangan Anthropic, Sabtu (12/9/2026).
Pelakunya pun beragam, mulai dari kelompok yang diduga mendapat dukungan negara, kriminal bermotif finansial, vendor spyware komersial, lembaga propaganda, hingga individu dengan kepentingan politik.
Baca Juga: Cara Bikin Foto ala Era 80-an yang Viral di Instagram Pakai ChatGPT
Claude Jadi “Operator” Serangan Siber
Di ranah kejahatan siber, peran Claude bergeser dari sekadar alat bantu menulis kode menjadi bagian dari operasi itu sendiri. Anthropic mendapati penggunaan AI untuk membangun malware, phishing kit, sampai perangkat surveillance,
Dalam beberapa kasus lainnya, AI juga dipakai untuk menjalankan perintah langsung ke jaringan korban dan mengekstrak data. Salah satu operasi multi-agent yang ditemukan bisa menjalankan reconnaissance dan pencurian data ke banyak target sekaligus.
Mengerikannya, satu serangan rampung dalam dua sampai tiga jam dan satu operator bisa menangani puluhan korban dalam waktu bersamaan.
Meski begitu, Anthropic mengingatkan keputusan penting masih berada di tangan manusia. Pemilihan target, monetisasi hasil serangan, dan evaluasi hasil umumnya tetap dilakukan operator.
Dengan kata lain, AI lebih berperan sebagai pengganda kecepatan, skala, dan efisiensi sebuah operasi.
AI Dipakai untuk Mata-matai Target
Penyalahgunaan Claude juga ditemukan dalam aktivitas surveillance. Anthropic mengidentifikasi operasi yang terkait dengan aktor di China, Iran, Afrika Barat, hingga perusahaan surveillance komersial.
AI digunakan untuk membangun software monitoring, menganalisis informasi, dan membuat sistem profiling terhadap individu atau kelompok tertentu.
Salah satu kasus paling mencolok melibatkan seorang konsultan yang diduga bekerja untuk badan intelijen negara Mali.
Menurut Anthropic, orang tersebut menggunakan Claude sebagai tenaga engineering utama untuk membangun sistem bernama Lakana 360, sebuah platform surveillance skala nasional yang dirancang untuk memantau data telekomunikasi dari sekitar 25 juta kartu SIM di tiga operator seluler negara tersebut.
Sementara dalam kasus lain, aktor yang terkait dengan Iran menggunakan Claude untuk membangun berbagai perangkat seperti extension Firefox yang bisa mengambil identitas pengguna dari media sosial serta tool analisis kelompok Telegram.
Penipuan Dating App Pakai Ribuan Persona Palsu
Red heart online dating Find Love Dating Couple Dating Happiness Tips
Tidak semua penyalahgunaan Claude berkaitan dengan operasi negara. Anthropic juga menemukan kasus penipuan berbasis aplikasi dating. Sebuah kelompok berbasis China dilaporkan mengoperasikan lebih dari 20 aplikasi dating dan menggunakan sekitar 4.700 persona palsu untuk berinteraksi dengan sedikitnya 25.000 pengguna.
AI membantu meningkatkan skala interaksi dengan korban sehingga operator tidak perlu menangani seluruh percakapan secara manual.
Kasus tersebut menunjukkan bagaimana AI berpotensi menurunkan biaya operasional scam sekaligus memungkinkan pelaku berinteraksi dengan jauh lebih banyak calon korban.
Anthropic: Ada Upaya Penyalahgunaan untuk Riset Biologis
Bagian lain yang cukup serius berkaitan dengan biological misuse. Anthropic mengatakan pihaknya menemukan dan menghentikan sejumlah percobaan menggunakan Claude untuk aktivitas penelitian biologis yang berpotensi berbahaya.
Salah satu contoh yang dilaporkan adalah permintaan bantuan membuat proposal penelitian gain-of-function terhadap virus chikungunya, termasuk perubahan yang dapat meningkatkan kemampuan virus menyebar atau menghindari sistem imun.
Reuters juga melaporkan ada upaya menggunakan Claude untuk penelitian terkait virus dan toksin, termasuk avian influenza. Namun, ini perlu diberi konteks. Temuan tersebut bukan berarti Claude secara otomatis berhasil membuat senjata biologis. 
Anthropic menggambarkannya sebagai upaya aktor untuk mendapatkan bantuan AI dalam riset yang memiliki potensi penyalahgunaan. Perusahaan mengatakan akun terkait telah diblokir dan perlindungan pada model-model yang lebih baru diperkuat.
Anthropic Blokir Akun dan Perketat Perlindungan Claude
Raksasa AI itu mengatakan, akun dan organisasi yang terkait dengan aktivitas tersebut telah diblokir.
Informasi dari investigasi juga digunakan untuk membangun sistem deteksi baru, memperketat safeguard Claude, serta dibagikan kepada aparat maupun mitra industri ketika diperlukan.
Menariknya, Anthropic mengatakan kasus penyalahgunaan dalam laporan ini melibatkan model Claude Haiku, Sonnet, dan Opus.
Perusahaan menyebut tidak menemukan aktivitas berbahaya pada model kelas Claude Fable atau Mythos, kecuali satu kasus terkait illicit distillation. Anthropic mengatakan model generasi tersebut memiliki perlindungan tambahan untuk mengurangi kemampuan menjalankan tugas berbahaya tertentu.
Laporan ini memperlihatkan tantangan baru industri AI. Semakin mampu sebuah model menjalankan pekerjaan kompleks secara mandiri, semakin besar pula potensinya membantu pengguna yang berniat buruk.
Di sisi lain, kasus yang ditemukan Anthropic juga memperlihatkan bahwa risiko tersebut masih sangat bergantung pada manusia yang menentukan target, tujuan, dan bagaimana hasil AI digunakan.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Senate Standing Committee on Information Technology and Telecommunication is set to take up a wide-ranging agenda on Monday, including the reported rebranding of Ufone following its merger with Telenor, Starlink’s launch, $800 million outstanding Etisalat dues, and alleged overcharging of mobile users by Jazz.
The committee will also examine internet shutdowns, telecom competition rules, security concerns over satellite connectivity, alleged transfer of sensitive government officials’ data to foreign entities and employment issues at Pak Datacom.
Senate Committee to Take Up Ufone Rebranding, Starlink Launch and Jazz Overcharging
The committee will receive a briefing from the Ministry of IT and Telecommunication (MoITT) on the reported change of Ufone’s name to “e&” following the Ufone-Telenor merger.
It will also seek an updated briefing on the launch of Starlink operations in Pakistan, amid continued interest in satellite-based internet services for underserved and remote areas.
The committee has also placed on its agenda a briefing by the IT Secretary on the reported shift of Pak Datacom to a foreign satellite, with members expected to examine the associated national security concerns.
Another key issue is the reported $800 million outstanding amount owed by Etisalat in connection with the privatisation of Pakistan Telecommunication Company Limited (PTCL). The committee will also seek minutes of PTCL Board meetings held during the last six months.
The committee will separately examine the status of court cases and stay orders involving LDI/FLL companies and seek a way forward from the Secretary, Ministry of IT and Telecommunication.
The Chairman PTA and Auditor General of Pakistan will brief the committee on a purported audit report alleging that Jazz charged mobile users Rs6.58 billion in excess, along with the reported provision allowing the operator to increase tariffs by up to 15 percent quarterly.
See Also: Pakistan Clears Rs 40.8 Billion PakSat-2 and Geo-AI Projects Under Uraan Pakistan
The committee will seek details of any action taken by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) to safeguard mobile consumers’ rights if the audit findings are substantiated.
The committee will also take up a serious cyber-security matter involving alleged obtaining and transfer of sensitive personal data of Pakistani government officers to foreign entities.
The Director General, National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA), will brief members on the alleged data transfer, the magnitude of the threat and measures being taken to prevent future data breaches.
The committee will also consider a point of public importance raised by Senator Atta-ur-Rehman concerning the closure of mobile services in Lakki Marwat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, raised in the Senate sitting on November 13, 2025.
A briefing will also be given on Universal Service Fund (USF) projects for provision of internet and telecommunications facilities in Qila Abdullah, Balochistan, including locations, approved allocations, current status and expected completion dates. The committee will also examine the number of villages and public-sector institutions expected to benefit and measures for extending digital access to remote areas of Balochistan.
The telecom competition regime will come under scrutiny as the committee will be briefed on whether the Telecom Competition Rules have been notified as required under Section 57 of the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996.
The committee will also consider the report of its sub-committee constituted to investigate and rectify issues relating to internet connectivity and the reported disappearance of diesel meant for telecom towers in different parts of the country.
Connectivity problems affecting 40 Pakistan Railways trains, including lack of signals and Wi-Fi network facilities, are also on the agenda.
In addition, the committee will consider a request from Pak Datacom employees concerning the termination of their employment.

Laporan terbaru menyebutkan, alasan kenapa Sony lepas Kojima dan studio miliknya karena masalah budget, jadwal pengembangan, hingga potensi keuntungan yang didapat.

Sejumlah sumber yang mengikuti proyek ambisius Hideo Kojima ini, Physint diketahui telah melewati beberapa target pengembangan dan diperkirakan akan menghabiskan biaya di atas budget, dan belum ada tanggal pasti kapan dirilis, sebagaimana dilaporkan Bloomberg, Sabtu (12/9/2026).
Sony sendiri belum mengonfirmasi secara langsung detail alasan tersebut benar atau tidak. Ketika mengumumkan keputusan untuk “putus” dari Hideo Kojima dan Kojima Production pada 10 September 2026, PlayStation hanya menyebut telah mengambil keputusan sulit untuk berhenti berkolaborasi untuk membuat Physint.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Keputusan Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) untuk meninggalkan Physint, proyek anction-espionage terbaru buatan Hideo Kojima dan Kojima Productions akhirnya terungkap.
Laporan terbaru menyebutkan, alasan kenapa Sony lepas Kojima dan studio miliknya karena masalah budget, jadwal pengembangan, hingga potensi keuntungan yang didapat.
Baca Juga: Hasil MPL ID S18: Geek Fam Akhiri 7 Kekalahan Beruntun
Sejumlah sumber yang mengikuti proyek ambisius Hideo Kojima ini, Physint diketahui telah melewati beberapa target pengembangan dan diperkirakan akan menghabiskan biaya di atas budget, dan belum ada tanggal pasti kapan dirilis, sebagaimana dilaporkan Bloomberg, Sabtu (12/9/2026).
Sony sendiri belum mengonfirmasi secara langsung detail alasan tersebut benar atau tidak. Ketika mengumumkan keputusan untuk “putus” dari Hideo Kojima dan Kojima Production pada 10 September 2026, PlayStation hanya menyebut telah mengambil keputusan sulit untuk berhenti berkolaborasi untuk membuat Physint.
Terkait dengan hubungan personal kedua belah pihak, raksasa teknologi berbasis di Jepang tersebut menyatakan hubungan mereka tetap baik.
Physint Potensi Delay dan Bikin Bengkak Budget
Xbox akan menerbitkan PHYSINT setelah Sony Interactive Entertainment mengakhiri kolaborasi proyek tersebut dengan Kojima Productions. (Doc: Gamingbible)
Kojima pertama kali mengumumkan Physint pada Januari 2024, di mana ini merupakan proyek baru dan ambisius dari Kojima Production bersama SIE. Kala itu, kreator seri Metal Gear ini menyebutkan, Physint sebagai game action-espionage generasi baru yang akan mulai dikerjakan secara penuh setelah Death Stranding 2: On the Beach.
Proyek tersebut juga dirancang untuk mengaburkan batas antara game dan film dengan dukungan teknologi serta talenta dari berbagai bidang.
Namun menurut Bloomberg, perkembangannya kemudian menimbulkan kekhawatiran dari sisi bisnis. Proyek tersebut dilaporkan telah melewati sejumlah deadline dan berada di jalur untuk menghabiskan biaya jauh lebih besar dari rencana awal.
Masalahnya menjadi semakin signifikan karena Physint sendiri masih bertahun-tahun dari rilis. Sony disebut enggan terus menginvestasikan dana yang bisa mencapai ratusan juta dolar pada proyek dengan tingkat risiko sebesar itu.
Ada pula persoalan eksklusivitas. Bloomberg melaporkan Sony kurang tertarik membiayai proyek dalam skala besar apabila game tersebut pada akhirnya tidak tetap eksklusif untuk hardware PlayStation.
Konteks ini cukup penting. Dua game Death Stranding memang diterbitkan Sony untuk PlayStation, tetapi franchise tersebut dimiliki oleh Kojima Productions dan telah berkembang ke platform lain. Dalam pandangan Sony, investasi besar tanpa kontrol eksklusif jangka panjang dilaporkan ikut mengubah perhitungan bisnis Physint.
Performa Death Stranding Jadi Pertimbangan
Laporan Bloomberg juga menyebut Death Stranding dan Death Stranding 2: On the Beach tidak mencapai ekspektasi revenue PlayStation. Namun bagian ini perlu dibedakan dari klaim bahwa kedua game tersebut merupakan kegagalan komersial.
Sony maupun Kojima Productions belum mengumumkan angka penjualan resmi Death Stranding 2. Alinea Analytics memperkirakan sekuelnya telah terjual sekitar 2,5 juta kopi di PS5 dan PC, tetapi angka tersebut merupakan estimasi perusahaan analisis pasar, bukan data resmi Sony.
Sebelum laporan Bloomberg muncul, CEO Kantan Games Serkan Toto juga berpendapat bahwa penurunan performa dari game pertama menuju sekuelnya mungkin telah membuat Sony lebih berhati-hati terhadap PHYSINT. Pernyataan tersebut tetap merupakan analisis, bukan konfirmasi tentang alasan keputusan perusahaan.
Physint Tetap Berlanjut Bersama Xbox
Keputusan Sony juga tidak berarti Physint dibatalkan sepenuhnya. Kojima mengungkap bahwa Kojima Productions menerima pemberitahuan dari PlayStation pada pertengahan Juni 2026 bahwa proyek tersebut akan dihentikan dari sisi kerja sama SIE.
Studio kemudian menghabiskan sekitar tiga bulan mencari partner baru sebelum akhirnya mencapai kesepakatan dengan Xbox.
Pada 10 September, Kojima Productions resmi mengonfirmasi Xbox sebagai partner baru PHYSINT. Studio menyatakan pengembangan tetap berjalan dan kerja sama tersebut sekaligus memperluas hubungan mereka dengan Xbox yang sebelumnya sudah terjalin melalui proyek horor OD.
Belum ada informasi resmi mengenai platform rilis ataupun jadwal peluncuran PHYSINT setelah pergantian partner tersebut.
Perpindahan Physint dari PlayStation ke Xbox pada akhirnya menjadi lebih dari sekadar perubahan publisher. Jika laporan Bloomberg akurat, keputusan Sony menunjukkan bagaimana skala biaya produksi game AAA, potensi keuntungan, serta nilai eksklusivitas semakin menjadi pertimbangan bahkan ketika sebuah proyek melibatkan kreator sekaliber Hideo Kojima.

Key Startup Funding Highlights Of The Week
Advanced hardware & technology emerged as the most-funded sector this week, with two startups raising a combined $121 Mn. The sector’s strong performance was largely driven by Pixxel’s mega $100 Mn round.
Following suit was ecommerce, which saw six startups raising $80 Mn. Nua’s $50 Mn fundraise was the biggest contributor, accounting for more than half of the sector’s total haul.
Beyond the top two sectors, AI also featured among the funded sectors. Meanwhile, foodtech clocked one deal and consumer services recorded two deals.
Early-stage funding remained subdued, with three startups raising a combined $3.3 Mn across pre-seed and seed rounds. This accounted for just 1% of the total $321.9 Mn raised during the week.
Peak XV Partners, Accel and Prath Ventures were the most active investors of the week, participating in two deals each.
Startup Fund Updates Of The Week
Healthtech-focused venture capital firm W Health Ventures closed its second fund at ₹700 Cr ($84 Mn), surpassing its initial ₹630 Cr target. The fund saw participation from family offices and institutional investors across India and the US.
Other Developments of The Week
EaseMyTrip cofounder and chairman Nishant Pitti has pledged 34.51 Cr shares, or 8.66% of the company’s total share capital, worth ₹211.9 Cr to Motilal Oswal Financial Services for “personal use”.
Circle Internet Group has agreed to acquire Peak XV-backed B2B cross-border payments startup Tazapay in an all-stock deal reportedly valued at nearly $400 Mn.
Swiggy is set to sell B2B retail distribution platform LYNK to Udaan in a share-swap deal, valuing the startup at ₹500 Cr. In return, the foodtech major will pick up a 2.8% stake in the B2B ecommerce unicorn. Swiggy will also invest another ₹75 Cr in Udaan for an additional 0.4% stake.

Sementara itu, Bigetron by Vitality (BTR) datang sebagai juara bertahan MPL ID sekaligus kampiun Games of the Future 2026. Namun, sempat tampil konsisten di awal musim, BTR harus kalah dua kali berturut-turut saat melawan Evos dan Alter Ego pada Week 4.
Pertandingan lainnya yang juga tidak kalah menarik ditonton adalah match Alter Ego melawan RRQ Hoshi, dan Navi vs Evos. Berikut adalah jadwal lengkap MPL ID S18 hari ini.

Team Liquid ID vs Bigetron by Vitality – 14:00 WIB

Team Liquid ID Tantang BTR
Jadwal MPL ID S18 hari ini Jadwal MPL ID S18 Hari Ini 5 September: Evos Uji Keperkasaan Bigetron by Vitality. (Doc: MPL ID)
Team Liquid ID vs Bigetron by Vitality akan membuka pertandingan hari kedua Week 5 MPL ID S18. TLID datang dengan modal empat kemenangan beruntun. Dalam empat pertandingan terakhir, mereka mampu mengalahkan EVOS, ONIC, Alter Ego, dan RRQ Hoshi.
Hasil tersebut membawa TLID memimpin klasemen dengan catatan enam kemenangan dan satu kekalahan.
Namun, Bigetron bukan lawan yang bisa dipandang sebelah mata. Selain berstatus juara MPL ID S17, BTR juga baru meraih gelar internasional di Games of the Future 2026.
Bigetron sempat mencatat lima kemenangan sebelum rekor tersebut terhenti pada Week 4. Mereka kalah 1-2 dari EVOS, kemudian takluk 0-2 dari Alter Ego.
Pertandingan melawan TLID akan menjadi kesempatan bagi Nnael dan kawan-kawan untuk bangkit sekaligus kembali mendekati papan atas klasemen.
Alter Ego vs RRQ Hoshi
Jadwal MPL ID S18 Hari Ini 29 Agustus: ONIC, RRQ, EVOS
Alter Ego akan menutup rangkaian pertemuan pertama mereka di Regular Season dengan menghadapi RRQ Hoshi. Tim asuhan Xepher datang dengan modal dua kemenangan beruntun. Alter Ego mengalahkan Geek Fam 2-0 dan Bigetron by Vitality 2-0 pada Week 4.
Alter Ego juga menjadi basis roster Timnas MLBB Indonesia yang akan tampil di Asian Games 2026. Di tengah persiapan menuju turnamen tersebut, mereka masih mampu menjaga posisi di papan atas MPL ID S18.
Di sisi lain, RRQ Hoshi masih berusaha keluar dari papan bawah. Setelah menjalani awal musim yang sulit, RRQ baru mengoleksi dua kemenangan dari tujuh pertandingan.
Duel menghadapi Alter Ego menjadi kesempatan penting bagi RRQ untuk menambah poin sebelum memasuki paruh kedua musim.
Navi vs Evos
Navi vs Evos menjadi pertandingan terakhir MPL ID S18 hari ini sekaligus pertemuan kedua kedua tim pada musim ini. Pada duel pertama di Week 1, Navi berhasil mengalahkan Evos dengan skor 2-1.
Sejak saat itu, performa Navi terus berkembang. Tim asuhan Ynot kini menempati papan atas klasemen dengan enam kemenangan dari delapan pertandingan.
Kehadiran Joshuaa di posisi jungler juga menjadi salah satu bagian penting dari performa Navi sepanjang musim ini.
Evos datang dengan kondisi berbeda. Mereka mencatat tiga kemenangan dan empat kekalahan dari tujuh pertandingan yang sudah dimainkan. Evos seharusnya menghadapi Dewa United pada Jumat (11/9/2026), tetapi pertandingan tersebut ditunda karena kondisi force majeure. Dengan demikian, duel melawan NAVI menjadi pertandingan pertama Evos pada Week 5.
Apakah Evos bisa membalas kekalahan mereka dari Navi pada pertemuan pertama?

items.title: How to Factory Reset an Android Phone Safely: A Step-by-Step Guide
items.summary: Google lets Android phone users safely factory reset their handset via two methods. You can either enter recovery mode to factory reset your device or go to the system settings menu to do the same. A complete factory reset deletes all the apps, locally saved files, system settings, photos, videos, and messages from your handset. It comes in handy if you have been facing various software-related issues or performance-related issues. On top of this, you must also factory reset your phone before selling it.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Platform media sosial (medsos) Instagram sedang diramaikan dengan beragam foto bergaya era 1980-an. Banyak pengguna mengunggah potret masa kini mereka yang sudah diubah menjadi tampilan retro lewat AI, lengkap dengan rambut bervolume, busana jadul, dan warna foto meyerupai hasil kamera analog.
Tren ini juga mengajak pengguna membayangkan seperti apa penampilan mereka masing-masing jika hidup pada masa tersebut. Menariknya, foto yang baru diambil pun bisa diolah menjadi potret bernuansa album keluarga lama, dengan latar studio, toko kaset, atau suasana jalan tempo dulu.
Lalu bagaimana cara bikin foto ala era 80-an ini? Salah satunya adalah menggunakan ChatGPT. Cukup unggah foto pribadi, lalu berikan instruksi atau prompt tentang pakaian, gaya rambut, hingga latar yang ingin ditampilkan.
Biar hasil foto ala era 80-an sesuai dengan harapan, prompt yang digunakan pun harus ditulis dengan jelas perubahan apa saja yang diinginkan sekaligus ciri wajah yang harus dipertahankan.
Tanpa panjang lebar, berikut ini adalah panduan membuat foto ala era 80-an dengan ChatGPT Images 2.5, lengkap dengan contoh prompt yang bisa disalin.
Cara Buat Foto ala Era 80-an Pakai ChatGPT Images 2.5
1. Siapkan Foto dengan Wajah Terlihat Jelas
Hal pertama yang perlu disiapkan adalah pilih foto dengan fokus tajam, dan wajah tidak tertutup aksesori. Foto setengah badan cocok untuk konsep yang menonjolkan perubahan pakaian serta gaya rambut.
Unggah foto yang ingin diubah ke era 80-an di ChatGPT. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Pastikan foto yang dipakai milik pribadi atau foto orang yang telah memberikan izin.
2. Unggah Foto dan Tentukan Konsep Retro
Buka ChatGPT di browser atau aplikasi di perangkat mobile, lalu tap garis panjang dan pendek di sisi kanan atas untuk memunculkan opsi Images. Klik template prompt “80’s flashback” atau langsung lampirkan foto melalui tombol unggah. Setelah foto terpasang, tulis prompt untuk mengedit gambar tersebut.
Tentukan satu konsep terlebih dahulu, seperti potret studio, pengunjung toko kaset, atau suasana kafe era 1980-an. Untuk nuansa Indonesia, coba arahkan latar ke toko kaset sederhana dengan rak kayu, poster musik, dan pencahayaan hangat.
Siapkan Prompt ChatGPT untuk Foto Retro
3. Masukkan Prompt Foto Retro
Berikut ini adalah contoh prompt ubah foto ala era 80-an yang bisa disesuaikan.
Gunakan foto yang saya unggah sebagai referensi utama. Buat potret realistis yang membayangkan saya berada di Indonesia pada era 1980-an.
Pertahankan identitas wajah, bentuk mata, hidung, bibir, warna kulit, serta perkiraan usia seperti foto referensi. Ubah pakaian menjadi jaket denim dengan kaus polos dan tata rambut yang terinspirasi era 1980-an.
Tempatkan saya di toko kaset dengan rak kayu dan deretan kaset sebagai latar. Gunakan pencahayaan hangat, warna sedikit pudar, serta grain film halus. Pertahankan tekstur kulit natural dan proporsi tubuh wajar.
Hindari smartphone, layar modern, teks tambahan, dan logo. Buat komposisi vertikal dengan rasio 4:5.
Instruksi mempertahankan wajah adalah target edit, bukan jaminan hasil akan identik dengan foto awal. Periksa kembali wajah sebelum menyimpan gambar.
4. Revisi Bagian yang Belum Sesuai
Jika hasil awal belum cocok, kirim instruksi lanjutan dalam percakapan yang sama. OpenAI menyarankan pengguna menjelaskan bagian yang ingin diubah sekaligus detail yang perlu dipertahankan.
Revisi hasil foto secara langsung. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Contoh revisi:
Baju yang dipakai terlalu sama. Ubah menjadi lebih beragam tetapi masih masuk di era 80-an. Ubah satu atau dua unsur per revisi agar arah koreksi mudah dinilai. Bandingkan hasil dengan foto awal, terutama pada wajah, jari, dan detail aksesori.
5. Sesuaikan Komposisi Sebelum Dibagikan
Untuk konsep unggahan vertikal, minta rasio 4:5. Jika gambar akan dipakai sebagai latar Story atau video vertikal, coba rasio 9:16 dan sisakan ruang untuk teks.
Periksa kembali potongan gambar sebelum mengunggah. Sertakan keterangan “Ilustrasi AI” agar foto kreasi retro tidak disalahartikan sebagai dokumentasi lama.

items.title: Mamuda Group Chairman and Board Delegation Visit Dangote Refinery, Meet Aliko Dangote
items.summary:
Hassan Hammoud, Chairman and CEO of Mamuda Group, led a delegation of board members on an official visit to the Dangote Refinery in Lagos today. The visit included a meeting with Aliko Dangote, President and Chief Executive of Dangote Group, and his daughter, Fatima Dangote, Executive Director of Dangote Group.
The delegation toured key sections of the refinery, one of the largest single-train petroleum refining facilities in the world. The visit gave Mamuda Group leadership firsthand insight into the scale of the operation and its role in Nigeria’s industrial and energy sectors.
Speaking after the visit, Hammoud described the Dangote Refinery as a defining achievement for African industry and a benchmark for large-scale investment on the continent. He commended President Bola Tinubu for fostering an environment that supports bold industrial investment in Nigeria, and praised Aliko Dangote and Fatima Dangote for their vision and leadership in delivering a project of this scale.

Festival film pendek tersebut menjadi bagian dari kampanye #CapCutFilmNaikLayar yang memberikan kesempatan bagi kreator dari berbagai daerah di Indonesia untuk menampilkan karya mereka di layar lebar.
Mengusung tema “Small Stories. Big Screen. One Nation”, acara ini menampilkan 10 karya terpilih dengan cerita yang mengambil beragam perspektif tentang Indonesia. Para kreator memanfaatkan CapCut Video Studio serta sejumlah fitur berbasis AI dalam proses pengembangan ide hingga penyuntingan film.
AI Content Fest menjadi salah satu contoh bagaimana aplikasi penyuntingan video mulai memperluas perannya dari sekadar alat editing menjadi bagian dari proses produksi konten. Namun, penggunaan AI dalam industri kreatif juga masih menyisakan sejumlah perdebatan, terutama terkait orisinalitas, hak cipta, dan sejauh mana teknologi seharusnya terlibat dalam menghasilkan sebuah karya.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
CapCut menggelar puncak AI Content Fest 2026 di CGV Grand Indonesia, Jakarta, pada 11 September 2026. Festival film pendek tersebut menjadi bagian dari kampanye #CapCutFilmNaikLayar yang memberikan kesempatan bagi kreator dari berbagai daerah di Indonesia untuk menampilkan karya mereka di layar lebar.
Mengusung tema “Small Stories. Big Screen. One Nation”, acara ini menampilkan 10 karya terpilih dengan cerita yang mengambil beragam perspektif tentang Indonesia. Para kreator memanfaatkan CapCut Video Studio serta sejumlah fitur berbasis AI dalam proses pengembangan ide hingga penyuntingan film.
AI Content Fest menjadi salah satu contoh bagaimana aplikasi penyuntingan video mulai memperluas perannya dari sekadar alat editing menjadi bagian dari proses produksi konten. Namun, penggunaan AI dalam industri kreatif juga masih menyisakan sejumlah perdebatan, terutama terkait orisinalitas, hak cipta, dan sejauh mana teknologi seharusnya terlibat dalam menghasilkan sebuah karya.
Baca Juga: OpenAI Rilis ChatGPT Images 2.5, Ini Fitur Barunya
AI Jadi Alat Pendukung Proses Kreatif
Pada acara tersebut, karya para finalis mendapatkan penilaian dan tanggapan dari sejumlah pelaku industri kreatif, termasuk Angga Dwimas Sasongko, Mouly Surya, Upie Guava, Dinda Prasetyo, dan Gustav Anandhita. Mereka memberikan masukan terkait ide, visual, hingga cara penyampaian cerita masing-masing film.
Diskusi yang turut dihadirkan dalam acara ini juga menempatkan AI sebagai alat bantu, bukan pengganti keputusan kreatif manusia. Aktor Lukman Sardi menilai teknologi dapat membantu proses persiapan karakter, sementara Mouly Surya melihat AI dapat digunakan untuk mengeksplorasi ide dan visual sebelum produksi. Kreator Gustav Anandhita juga menyoroti kemampuan AI dalam mempercepat eksperimen dan iterasi.
Dorong Kreator Eksplorasi Format Baru
Selain pemutaran film, AI Content Fest 2026 memberikan penghargaan dalam delapan kategori, mulai dari Student Awards, Best Story, Best Visual, hingga Best AI Micro Film. CapCut juga menampilkan video musik berbasis AI hasil kolaborasi dengan musisi Raim Laode untuk lagu “Dunia Yang Nanti”.
Di sisi lain, festival seperti ini menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan AI dalam produksi konten semakin mudah diakses oleh kreator individu. CapCut juga menyebut telah menerapkan invisible watermark dan Content Credentials dari C2PA untuk mendukung transparansi konten. Meski begitu, kemudahan teknologi tetap perlu diimbangi pemahaman kreator mengenai penggunaan materi berhak cipta dan batas antara bantuan AI dengan karya yang sepenuhnya dihasilkan mesin.

items.content:
By Musa Ubandawaki, Sokoto
SOKOTO: Sokoto-based Islamic cleric, Sheikh Musa Ayuba Lukuwa, has appealed for calm following an alleged knife attack on him shortly after the conclusion of Jumu’at prayer at his mosque in the Mabera area of Sokoto metropolis.
Lukuwa, who sustained a minor injury around his neck during the incident on Friday, said he was well and urged his followers and members of the public not to panic over his condition.
The cleric made the appeal in a video circulated on social media, in which he appeared with a plaster covering part of his neck.
He said the injury was not life-threatening and assured his followers that he was in stable condition.
Lukuwa also called on his supporters to refrain from anger, retaliation or any action capable of escalating tension in the metropolis.
According to him, the assailant approached him shortly after the Jumu’at prayer and allegedly attempted to attack him with a knife.
He expressed appreciation to his followers who immediately rallied around him, saying their swift intervention helped to shield him from the attacker and prevented the situation from resulting in more serious injury.
The cleric commended those who assisted him during the incident, describing their response as crucial to his safety.
His appearance in the video came amid concerns among his followers and residents of Sokoto following reports of the attack, which have attracted significant attention on social media.
Lukuwa, however, urged his supporters to remain peaceful and avoid taking the law into their own hands.
He thanked his followers and well-wishers for their concern, prayers and solidarity, assuring them that there was no need for panic over his condition.
The cleric further urged members of the public to remain calm and allow the relevant authorities to investigate the incident and take appropriate action in accordance with the law.
The attack has also renewed attention on controversies surrounding some of Lukuwa’s recent religious pronouncements.
He appealed to his followers to exercise restraint, stressing the need to prevent the incident from triggering further confrontation or reprisals in the state.

Lionel Messi is used to appearing in the history books, but this time the fact could be related to something that no trophy can show on its own: the duration of his longevity. Exactly 20 years passed between his first nomination, in 2006, and the current one.
The most striking detail is not only his name on the list, but the time that has passed since that first appearance in 2006; with the nomination being completely official and concrete, exactly one generation has passed between the two moments
The record Lionel Messi reached and seems unbeatable
That first nomination came when Messi was still building his name in international football. At just 19 years old, he had already begun to draw attention for his talent and his leading role at Barcelona.
From that moment to the present, history changed forever. The captain of the Argentine national team ended up becoming one of the award’s biggest winners, claiming eight Ballon d’Or awards and establishing a hegemony that defined an era.
With his 2026 nomination, Messi established a gap of exactly 20 years from his first appearance among the candidates, in 2006.
The Rosario native already holds the sole distinction of having won the trophy in three different decades (the 2000s, 2010s, and 2020s) while representing three different clubs (FC Barcelona, PSG, and Inter Miami). The nomination comes after a year in which Messi played a leading role with Inter Miami and with the Argentina national team, with whom he reached the final of the 2026 World Cup.
And finally, if he takes home the award next October 26 in London, he will extend his historic lead to 9 Ballon d’Ors. If he wins, Messi will reach nine Ballon d’Ors and widen the gap over Cristiano Ronaldo, who has five, to four.
If he wins the award on October 26, Messi will become, at 39 years old, one of the oldest winners in the world.
