items.content:
OWERRI — Polaris Bank has expressed grief over the killing of one of its branch managers, identified as Mr Ossy, who was reportedly shot dead by suspected kidnappers at the Federal University of Technology, Owerri, FUTO, Imo State.
The incident occurred on Sunday, September 6, 2026, within the university premises, while the banker, who was based in Owerri, was reportedly taking his children to the institution.
Two female students were also reportedly abducted during the incident.
In a statement issued on Tuesday and signed by the Head, Brand Management and Corporate Communication of Polaris Bank, Rasheed Bolarinwa, the bank said the deceased was attacked by hoodlums while taking his children to the university.
The bank said his children managed to escape, but he was killed in the incident.
“We are deeply saddened by the tragic death of our Branch Manager and extend our heartfelt condolences to his family, friends, colleagues, and loved ones during this difficult time.
“The unfortunate incident occurred on Sunday, when he was accosted by the hoodlums, and while the children managed to escape from the scene, he was not that lucky,” the statement said.
The bank said the incident was being investigated by relevant law enforcement agencies and expressed confidence that the circumstances surrounding the killing would be established.
“Our thoughts and prayers remain with the family of the deceased, and we respectfully urge the public to allow the authorities to complete their investigations,” it added.
Meanwhile, the management of FUTO confirmed that a visitor to the university was fatally shot during the incident and that two female students were reportedly abducted.
In a statement signed by the Registrar, Chinonso Uba, the university said the incident occurred on Sunday, adding that the circumstances were under investigation by security agencies.
“Management is engaging with the appropriate authorities regarding the safe recovery of the students,” the statement said.
The university assured students, staff, parents and other members of the community that their safety remained a priority, adding that additional security measures were being implemented in collaboration with security agencies.
It urged members of the university community to remain calm and vigilant, avoid unnecessary movement and promptly report suspicious activities.
Following the incident, FUTO management met with the Imo State Commissioner of Police, CP Audu Garba Bosso, on Monday over security concerns around the university and its host communities.
Bosso reportedly assured the university management of intensified security around the institution and neighbouring communities, particularly the Ihiagwa, Eziobodo, Obinze and Nekede axes.
Meanwhile, a source who spoke on condition of anonymity said a proposed peaceful protest by some students over the killing was cancelled following the university’s reaffirmation of its ban on unruly and rowdy gatherings after examinations.
The ban was adopted by the FUTO Senate at its 495th and 501st meetings held on August 31, 2023, and April 29, 2024, respectively, following concerns over the destruction of university property, particularly during celebrations by graduating students.
The university management reaffirmed the prohibition at its seventh meeting held on Monday, September 7, 2026, warning students against activities capable of disrupting peace on the campus and in neighbouring communities.
The prohibited activities include rowdy behaviour, public revelry, disorderly conduct, littering, indiscriminate disposal of waste, blocking or obstructing roads and entrances, and damaging or defacing university property.
The management also warned against any conduct capable of threatening the safety and security of the university community.

items.author: Nwafor
items.content:
By Ikechukwu Nnochiri
Despite the controversy that trailed his selection as keynote speaker at the recent Annual General Conference of the Nigerian Bar Association (NBA), George Weah, immediate past President of the Republic of Liberia, took the legal body to task, outlining what it must do to help the country and the continent.
Weah, who served as President of Liberia from 2018 to January 2024 before losing his bid for re-election to Joseph Boakai, insisted that the NBA, as the continent’s biggest umbrella body of lawyers with a membership of over 150,000, must shed mediocrity and stand firmly for justice in order to safeguard the rule of law and democracy in Africa.
Speaking on the theme “Beyond Limits,” the former footballer who swapped the pitch for politics maintained that Nigeria holds the key to the promise of the entire continent.
According to him, “When the NBA decides to go beyond limits, the legal architecture of Africa itself grows stronger.”
Addressing legal eggheads at the conference held in Port Harcourt, the former Ballon d’Or winner said:
“I want to thank you for choosing a theme as bold as ‘Beyond Limits.’
“When I first heard it, I smiled, because if my own life has taught me one thing, it is that limits are very often not the walls we think they are. They are only the edge of what someone has tried so far.
“I did not come into this hall as a lawyer, and I will not pretend to be one. I grew up in the ghetto of ‘Gibraltar’ in Monrovia, Liberia, where very few people believed that a boy raised largely by his grandmother would one day stand on the world’s biggest football stages, or take an oath as President of the Republic of Liberia.
“Allow me to speak to you about two things today: first, the Bar and the Bench as guardians of our democracy, and the dangers that threaten that guardianship in West Africa today; and second, what it means for our peoples and our continent to truly go beyond limits, not in slogan, but in substance.
“Let me start with a simple truth I came to understand not as a student of law, but as a man who has sat in the highest office of a nation. “Democracy does not survive on the strength of elections alone. Elections are the doorway into democracy, not the house itself.
“What holds the house up, what keeps the roof from collapsing on the people who live inside it, are institutions, and among the most important of these, in every serious nation, is an independent judiciary, protected by a fearless, principled Bar.
“And let me be plain about something else, because it is often the more dangerous of the two threats to democracy.
“The danger is not only that soldiers might seize power in the night, or that a defeated candidate might refuse to leave office.
“It is also that a leader who arrives in office through a free and fair election can, over time and often gradually, begin to govern like the very dictators the ballot was meant to guard against, leaning on the judiciary until it bends to his will, and strong-arming the legislature until it becomes an echo chamber rather than a check on his power.
“A tyrant with a certificate of return is still a tyrant. Democracy, properly understood, does not end on election night. It is tested every single day afterward, in how power treats the courts and the parliament that exist to restrain it.”
Continuing, ex-President Weah argued that the rule of law is not an abstract phrase for law school lecture halls.
He described it as the practical guarantee that a citizen’s rights depend not on who holds office or what favors they can secure, but on equal protection under the law for everyone, regardless of status or position in society.
“The moment that guarantee weakens, everything else in a nation weakens with it: investment, security, public trust, and peace itself.
“And here is the uncomfortable part: this danger does not only come from the coup-makers who seize power in the night. It also comes from governments that call themselves democratic, through budget manipulation, questionable appointments, pressure on judges, and a mindset that treats courts as a convenience rather than a check.
“We have seen nations where a judiciary’s own budget must first pass through the executive it is meant to hold accountable.
“We have seen special courts created not to deliver justice but to secure political outcomes, and dozens of judges dismissed in a single stroke by presidential decree.
“And we have seen, across our region since 2020, an unsettling pattern of soldiers stepping over constitutions altogether.
“I raise these examples because this Bar, to which you belong and have gathered here in your thousands, cannot afford to assume that Nigeria, or Liberia, or any of us, is somehow immune.
“A court’s decision must mean what it says, without anyone’s political permission; it is what protects a nation from sliding, gradually but progressively, into the very conditions we condemn when soldiers do it with guns. “This is why I say to you: the Nigerian Bar Association is not merely a professional association negotiating welfare for its members.
“You are a standing sentinel of this Republic’s democracy. When the Bar is silent, courts become easier to capture.
“When the Bar speaks with one voice, as guardians of the bench, the executive branch thinks twice before even dreaming of interference. “That tradition is not decoration. It is duty, because protecting the independence of your courts, and the rights of the ordinary Nigerian citizen, is protecting democracy itself, here in Nigeria and across the region,” he added.
Contending that Africa’s limits are not a matter of talent, Weah identified the problem as a lack of infrastructure and organized will to allow brilliance to flourish.
He said: “This room is proof of it. The Nigerian Bar counts among its numbers some of the finest legal minds in the world, many of whom have built extraordinary careers abroad, in London, in Washington, in the Gulf.
“That is nothing to be ashamed of, but it is something we must be strategic about. For too long we have called this only ‘brain drain,’ as though it is purely a loss.
“I ask you to think instead about brain circulation, pulling that expertise back into nation-building without demanding anyone abandon what they have earned and learned abroad.
“Our African diaspora already sends home well over one hundred billion dollars a year in remittances alone, more than the foreign aid and investment Africa receives combined.
“Imagine that same energy formally invited into legal reform and judicial modernization, as a deliberate national strategy.
“Because the fight against poor governance and economic deprivation is not one we can afford to enter with half our talent unaccounted for.
“A Nigerian-trained lawyer on an arbitration panel in Paris, or advising a global institution in New York, is not lost talent; it is talent operating at the highest global standard, available to be called home if we organize the bridge for it to cross.
“This, too, is what going Beyond Limits must mean for us: refusing to accept that our infrastructural and governance challenges are any kind of ceiling on what is possible. I did not accept the limits the slum seemed to set for me.
“I say this to you not as a theory but as something I have lived. In November 2023, when the early, provisional results of our run-off election made clear which way our country had voted, I did not wait for the count to be completed or for the final results to be formally announced before I picked up the telephone to congratulate my successor. “There were those around me who suggested patience, who argued that a sitting president owes it to himself to contest every figure until the very last vote is certified.
“I chose otherwise. I chose to concede while the counting was still underway, because I have always believed, and still believe, that the will of the people must stand above the ambition of any one man in a democratic setting.
“Once elections do not follow democratic precepts, it is very dangerous for the peace and security of a country.
“When your leadership invited me to speak on the theme Beyond Limits, it resonated with the very core of my life’s journey.
“In the law, brilliance without discipline leads to compromised justice. Discipline is the quiet commitment to doing what is right, what is necessary, and what is ethical, even when no one is watching.
“As legal minds, your hard work secures the liberties of the common man and fortifies the rule of law.
“For the legal profession in Nigeria and across Africa, perseverance means standing firm for justice even when the political or social winds blow fiercely against you.
“My distinguished friends, Nigeria holds a key to the promise of our whole continent. When the Nigerian Bar Association decides to go beyond limits, the legal architecture of Africa itself grows stronger.
“Let us commit today to breaking the chains of mediocrity: applying discipline to our craft, hard work to our duty, respect to our peers, perseverance to our trials, and faith to our foundational values.
“Let us all stand for true justice, for the rule of law that builds greater unity, that makes a nation more attractive to investment, and that creates a stable environment in place of internal conflict.
“True justice is blind. It does not know politics. It does not see family or friendship. It knows only the truth, and it interprets the law the same way whether or not anyone is watching.
“Let us all interpret the law fairly, and apply it more effectively. Let justice prevail, and be done to all men and women, rather than spending our energy on division.
“The true measure of a lawyer is not how many cases you have won, how many titles you hold, or how much you earn. It is this: when the country needs courage, do you have the courage to stand?
“The law must never be an instrument of chaos. It must never become a weapon of war. “It must remain what it was always meant to be: an instrument of remedy, of peace, of unity, and of accountability; an instrument for humanity, for transparency, and for truth. “As a lawyer, you must be able to protect the law whether the voice before you is rich, poor, or powerful.
“As the law provides, you must be able to stand in defense of those who cannot defend themselves. You must ensure that due process is honored.
“Let us respect the law, and let us interpret it faithfully. I say to you, as with Lady Justice herself: carry the scales of substance and of justice, and let nothing tip them but the truth.
“My brothers and sisters, Nigerians depend on you.
“West Africa depends on you. Africa depends on you. The world depends on you. Democracy depends on you. And free elections depend on you.
“So I say to all of you here today: Africa must continue in peaceful coexistence, and we must all stand up for the rule of law. Stand up for fairness. Stand up for impartiality. Stand up for gender equality. Stand up for equality. Stand up for humanity.
“Stand up for peace and for democracy. Stand up against discrimination. Stand up for accountability. Stand up for free and fair elections,” he added.
Some lawyers had opposed the choice of Weah as the conference’s guest speaker, citing his alleged disregard for the rule of law during his tenure.
Their misgivings, however, were likely drowned out by the thunderous applause that greeted his presentation at the conference.
The post What the NBA must do to help Nigeria, Africa grow — Ex-Liberian President Weah appeared first on Vanguard News.

National Leader of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Senator Seriake Dickson, has said he does not belong to either the Obidient or Kwankwasiyya political support groups, insisting that his allegiance is to the NDC.
Dickson made the clarification during an interview on Arise TV’s Prime Time on Wednesday, while speaking on the relationship between the party and the support bases of its presidential and vice-presidential candidates, Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso.
“I’m not a member of Kwankwasiyya. I’m not a member of Obedient. I am NDC,” Dickson said.
He said although the Obidient and Kwankwasiyya groups have their distinct identities and are free to operate independently, their principals are the NDC’s candidates for the 2027 presidential election.
“Kwankwasiyya has a right to be on its own under the constitution, and same for the Obedient group. Their principals are our candidates, presidential candidate and running-mate,” he said.
According to Dickson, the NDC has already resolved its internal issues by deciding its candidates and is now focused on winning the 2027 election.
“There are no internal battles to fight in the NDC. We have decided candidature. The next stage of the battle, strategically, is to win the election,” he said.
He added that the party expected all its supporters and members of the various groups associated with its candidates to take their campaigns to Nigerians rather than engage in internal disputes.
Dickson said the NDC’s relationship with Obi and Kwankwaso was not new, noting that they had worked together in different political settings over the years.
“I have held several meetings and even before now, we used to meet over the years. We have been colleagues, partners and friends, sometimes in the same camp, in the same party, other times, but always meeting,” he said.
He described the party’s overriding objective as securing victory in the 2027 election, saying the different political groups supporting Obi and Kwankwaso should unite around that goal.
“We have a partnership that is committed to winning the next elections. That is the most important thing,” Dickson said.

items.author: efosataiwo@vanguardngr.com
items.content:
The Nigeria Police Force has arrested a 27-year-old woman, Hafsat Abubakar, over the alleged creation and circulation of a forged document claiming that fintech company OPay Nigeria Limited was shutting down its operations.
The arrest was announced on Wednesday by the Force Public Relations Officer, Anietie Iniedu, during a press briefing at the Nigeria Police Force National Cybercrime Centre in Abuja.
Iniedu said the investigation followed a formal petition submitted by OPay Digital Services Limited on August 31, 2026, seeking the investigation and arrest of those behind the document.
“On the 31st of August 2026, the Nigeria Police Force National Cybercrime Centre, NPF-NCCC, received a formal petition from OPAY Digital Services Limited through the office of the Deputy Inspector-General of Police in charge of the Force Criminal Investigation Department, Abuja, requesting urgent investigation, tracing and apprehension of persons responsible for the creation and circulation of a fraudulent document falsely presented as an official communication issued by OPay Nigeria Limited,” Iniedu said.
He said the NCCC subsequently deployed digital forensic tools to analyse the document and trace its origin.
“Upon receipt of the approved petition, the Nigeria Police Force National Cybercrime Centre, NPF-NCCC, deployed digital forensic tools to analyse the content, which was traced to a post on the X handle, @Hafsat_ER_ABBA, registered and operated by one Hafsat Abubakar,” he said.
The police spokesman said operatives arrested Abubakar on September 4, 2026.
“On the 4th of September 2026, police operatives of the NCCC arrested one Hafsat Abubakar, a 27-year-old female graduate of Library and Information Science from Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria,” Iniedu said.
Recall Digital financial services provider OPay dismissed reports claiming that it will suspend operations from Tuesday, September 1, 2026.
The rumour, which circulated on social media, claimed that the fintech would embark on an indefinite break and stop processing transactions and account-related services.
The report also urged OPay customers to withdraw their funds ahead of the purported shutdown, prompting concerns among some users.
However, OPay has described the claim as false and malicious, assuring customers that it has no plans to stop its operations.
“OPay is not going on break by September. We’re here, and we’re going nowhere!” the company said in a social media post on Sunday.
The fintech also urged customers to be cautious of unofficial information circulating online, noting that genuine communications from the company can be distinguished from fake posts.
“True OPay users know how to identify our official communications. Take a closer look at the viral post, and you’ll spot the red flags,” it said.
OPay advised members of the public to verify information before sharing it, particularly when such claims concern their finances or accounts.
The company added, “Always verify before you share. Filter the noise!”
It further encouraged customers to rely on its verified social media platforms for updates and other official communications.

items.content:
Chelsea fought back from two goals down to beat Leeds 6-3 as Cole Palmer and Danny Welbeck rescued the Blues in a League Cup third-round classic on Wednesday.
Xabi Alonso’s side were in danger of crashing out following Tarik Muharemovic’s first-half opener and a Brenden Aaronson goal soon after the interval at Stamford Bridge.
But Alonso sent on England forward Palmer, along with Morgan Rogers, Pedro Neto and Reece James, at half-time and the decision inspired Chelsea’s stirring escape act.
Palmer struck twice to haul Chelsea level and Neto put them ahead before Welbeck made it four.
Dominic Calvert-Lewin got one back for Leeds, but Valentin Barco and Welbeck netted to ensure Chelsea moved into the fourth round in style.
Losing 2-1 at Premier League champions Arsenal on Sunday had ended Alonso’s three-game winning start to his reign.
But the Chelsea boss got back on track with the kind of chaotic victory that has defined his brief spell in charge.
Chelsea have scored 16 goals in Alonso’s first five matches to showcase their attacking talent.
But they have conceded 10 to prove the defensive issues that plagued them last season have not gone away since Alonso’s arrival.
Despite spending £349 million ($472 million) during the transfer window, Chelsea ended the Arsenal game with James and Malo Gusto — two players who are usually right-backs — operating in central midfield.
Alonso fielded another untested alignment in the midfield engine room as teenage debut Reggie Watson lined up alongside Argentine youngster Barco.
The 16-year-old Watson — the fourth youngest player in Chelsea’s history — is the son of Ben Watson, who scored Wigan’s FA Cup final winner against Manchester City in 2013.
Alonso’s decision to make nine changes was in danger of backfiring when Leeds went in front from a 23rd-minute corner.
– Chelsea goal spree –
Harry Wilson’s delivery to the far post caught Chelsea flat-footed and Bosnia defender Muharemovic powered a header past Mike Penders for his first Leeds goal.
Leeds seemed unfazed by the introduction of Chelsea’s stars at the interval and they struck again in the 48th minute.
Ethan Ampadu’s cross was flicked on by Lukas Nmecha and Aaronson finished with aplomb.
But Chelsea earned a crucial lifeline five minutes later when Daniel James’s soft challenge on Pep Chavarria was deemed worthy of a penalty that Palmer stroked home.
Just two minutes later, Chelsea were level when Palmer’s shot trickled past Leeds’ debutant goalkeeper Michael Zetterer.
Suddenly, Chelsea were rampant and Neto curled their third goal beyond Zetterer from 20 yards in the 60th minute.
Alonso’s men made it four goals in the space of just 12 minutes as Welbeck turned and smashed a powerful strike past Zetterer’s weak attempted save.
Calvert-Lewin reduced the deficit in the 75th minute with a clinical finish from Noah Okafor’s pass.
But Barco swept into the empty net after Zetterer made a hash of Rogers’s cross in the 80th minute.
And Welbeck rounded off the goal spree in stoppage time with a cushioned header from Barco’s shot.
League Cup holders Manchester City and Premier League champions Arsenal play their third-round ties next week against Norwich and Ipswich respectively.
Liverpool, who host Tottenham, and Manchester United, who welcome Brighton to Old Trafford, are also in action next week.
Newcastle, Crystal Palace, Bournemouth, Sunderland and Bradford all advanced to the fourth round on Tuesday.

items.content:
Alexis Mac Allister did his case for an improved Liverpool contract no harm with the winner as Andoni Iraola got off to a winning Champions League start by beating Atletico Madrid 2-1 on Wednesday.
Mac Allister expressed his frustration at not being offered a new deal on the eve of the match, but responded by blasting home from the edge of the box to cap Liverpool’s comeback.
Marcos Llorente had given Atletico an early lead before Dominik Szoboszlai levelled before half-time.
Victory came at a cost for the Reds, though, as new signing Bradley Barcola limped off with a calf injury.
For the first time three players who cost in excess of £100 million ($135 million) were named in the same side as Barcola made his Anfield debut alongside Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz in the Liverpool attack.
Isak fired just wide after a purposeful break by Szoboszlai in an energetic start by Liverpool in the first Champions League game of Iraola’s career.
But in their desperation to pour forward, the Reds left themselves wide open to the counter-attack.
Atletico were humbled 3-0 by Athletic Bilbao on Saturday to cap an underwhelming start to the season by Diego Simeone’s men.
Julian Alvarez’s future has cast a cloud over Atletico on and off the field for the past few months after his desire for a move to Barcelona was steadfastly rejected by the club’s hierarchy.
The Argentine was handed his first start of the season and cut open the Liverpool defence for the opening goal.
Llorente, who named his dog Anfield after scoring twice in Atletico’s last 16 win over Liverpool in 2020, raced onto Alvarez’s pass to score his fifth goal in three visits to Anfield with the Spanish side.
– Barcola’s first start –
Only a brilliant save by Alisson Becker denied Alvarez from long range before the Liverpool fightback began.
Barcola twice should have marked his first chance to impress his new fanbase with a goal.
The French winger, who could cost up to £123 million, failed to squeeze the ball past Jan Oblak with just the giant Slovenian to beat.
However, Liverpool kept the attack alive and Ronald Araujo’s flick teed up Szoboszlai to find the bottom corner on 40 minutes.
Barcola missed an even better chance for his first Liverpool goal when he fired wide after being played in by Wirtz early in the second half.
Again, though, the reprieve was brief for the visitors.
Mac Allister had been linked with a move to Atletico during the transfer window and expressed his sadness at not being offered a new contract by Liverpool, while Szoboszlai and Ryan Gravenberch have agreed new deals in recent months.
The Argentine international arrowed in a shot from outside the box on his weaker left foot and celebrated wildly in front of the Kop.
Liverpool’s joy was short-lived as Barcola pulled up holding his calf before the hour mark in what Iraola will hope is not a serious setback.
Iraola will be much happier with his side’s defensive display in the second half.
Alvarez fired too close to Alisson with one of the visitors’ few clear sights of goal.
A last-ditch challenge by Robin Le Normand denied Isak a third goal to round off a fine night for Liverpool.
But Iraola was able to celebrate his first statement win since taking charge.

items.author: Oboh
items.content:
By Prince Osuagwu
The Nigerian Communications Commission, NCC, has allayed fears that its new Device Management System, DMS, designed to strengthen Type Approval compliance for mobile devices in Nigeria, could give the regulator access to users’ personal data and communications.
The Commission, in a statement by its Director, Corporate Affairs, Nnenna Ukoha, maintained that the insinuation was unfounded, stressing that the platform was designed solely for device identification and regulatory compliance.
The clarification followed concerns over the Commission’s plan to electronically determine the Type Approval compliance of SIM-enabled devices through the DMS, which is being deployed to improve oversight of the country’s communications device ecosystem.
According to the NCC, the system will maintain device identification information, including the International Mobile Equipment Identity, IMEI, numbers of devices operating in Nigeria, but will not provide access to the contents of users’ devices or personal communications.
The Commission said the initiative is part of efforts to ensure that communications devices imported, sold and used in Nigeria meet applicable technical and regulatory standards.
Under Section 132(2) of the Nigerian Communications Act 2003, licensed service and facilities providers, equipment manufacturers and suppliers are required to obtain Type Approval from the Commission before communications equipment can be sold or used in Nigeria.
The NCC said the Device Management System would also help identify non-compliant and illegally imported devices, improve network performance and strengthen consumer confidence in devices sold in the country.
It added that stolen devices reported through the appropriate channels could also be identified and blocked from operating across Nigerian mobile networks.
The Commission has commenced the first phase of implementing the automated Type Approval compliance framework, working with the Nigeria Customs Service, Original Equipment Manufacturers, OEMs, importers and relevant market associations.
The first phase is focused on onboarding existing devices currently held in stock and ensuring that devices imported into Nigeria going forward are appropriately registered and authenticated.
NCC’s Director of Technical Standards and Network Integrity, Engr. Edoyemi Ogoh, said the Type Approval Business Rules issued in August 2024 provided the regulatory framework for establishing a Central Equipment Identity Register, CEIR, which maintains a registry of SIM-enabled communications devices in Nigeria.
He said the central registry of IMEI numbers would enable the Commission to ensure that devices imported into, sold and used in Nigeria comply with applicable standards.
“With the deployment of this system, all SIM-enabled communications devices brought into the country must be registered before they are sold. Devices that are not duly registered will not be permitted to operate on Nigerian networks,” Ogoh said.
He added that the system would make it easier to identify illegally imported and non-compliant devices, while stolen devices could be blocked from use across Nigerian mobile networks.
The NCC stressed that the DMS is therefore a regulatory and device-identification tool, rather than a platform for accessing or monitoring users’ personal communications.

items.author: efosataiwo@vanguardngr.com
items.content:
By Dickson Omobola
Former Governor Samuel Ortom of Benue State has condemned the blockade of the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, Peter Obi, from visiting Yelwata community in Guma Local Government Area of the state, accusing Governor Hyacinth Alia of disrespecting the rule of law.
Ortom said the incident was a reflection of the situation in Benue, noting that it was unfortunate that a clergyman who should be telling the truth was telling lies.
Speaking on Politics Today, a Channels Television programme, Wednesday, Ortom alleged that Alia was behind the incident and challenged the governor to swear by the Bible that he was not aware of what happened.
His words: “In Benue State, we have a government that does not believe in the rule of law. We have a government in Benue State that is out for lawlessness. We begin to wonder, if all of us will not respect the rule of law, but also join him in ensuring lawlessness, where are we going to be? This is a supposed man of God, a supposed priest of the Catholic Church. We know that even in the scriptures that we lean on, it says that we must respect the laws of the land.
“But unfortunately, we have somebody who says he’s a Catholic priest and does not respect the rule of law in any way. I condemn what happened yesterday. It is wrong not to allow Peter Obi to visit Benue and sympathise with those people whose people were killed. It was wrong, and that is the kind of government that we have in Benue State today.
“Governor Alia has been doing it. Governor Alia was one person who said, ‘No Alia, no Benue,’ and went to remove a Chief Judge through these thugs. Alia sent tippers with loads of sand to block the Chief Judge’s office. He has been saying that if nobody accepts him, he will not accept any other person.
“I say that it is unfortunate that somebody who is supposed to be a reverend father is telling lies. Can he come out and swear by the Bible that he claims to be a reverend priest and say that he was not aware of what happened yesterday? It was a deliberate attempt. He did it. Ask any other person.
“Alia himself, the governor of Benue State, is involved in this matter. He cannot deny that. I am not supporting Peter Obi. But it is wrong.”
Meanwhile, former Governor of Bayelsa State and national leader of the NDC, Seriake Dickson, called for a thorough investigation and prosecution of those involved, saying Nigerians deserve to know the extent of complicity.
Speaking on Newsnight, an Arise TV programme, Wednesday, he said there had been allegations that some government officials were involved in the incident and urged the authorities to establish whether the allegations were true.
His words: “This happening, while campaigns have officially started, sends a very dangerous signal, and the point has to be made clearly that this is not only condemnable, it is criminal. This is rascality of the highest order, and this is intolerable. There has to be punishment for this, so that we can say, well, however bad things may have gone in this country, we can’t accept this to go on. Otherwise, we may have a situation where candidates will be attacked everywhere, or people will be encouraged wrongly to think or assume that a presidential candidate, or even any other candidate or any other Nigerian, needs a visa of some kind to be able to participate in any activity he or she wants to, or to visit any state.
“No Nigerian citizen, by our Constitution and our laws, needs anyone’s permission or approval to visit a state. More so, when we are dealing with a presidential candidate, a high-profile personality, at a period of political campaigns, you stop the man with thugs. No, that is not encouraging. It sounds almost obscene. It tells where we have gone as a country, but we must speak against it.
“We have just listened to the remarks that the Commissioner of Police made, even though we were all concerned about what steps the police took at that venue, or to prevent it. One of the first things I asked when it occurred, I called the national chairman and asked, was there notification to the state authorities? And they brought a copy of a letter, a letter by the state chairman to the Commissioner of Police.
“Once you have informed the Commissioner of Police about the visit or activities of a politician or a high-profile personality, that is to be treated as information to the state authorities because the Commissioner of Police is the chief law enforcement officer of every state.
“I’m pleased with the steps they have taken. I’m not surprised, but steps should have been taken to prevent it. By tomorrow, there will be a formal petition from our party to the Inspector-General and then to the Attorney-General of the Federation. And I think we have gotten to a point, before campaigns really kick off, for even the President of the country to weigh in on this.
“He is sitting at the apex of the political system, and he’s not just President of the APC, he’s not just President of a particular set of people. He is the President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, and his job is not to talk about economic policies, which we disagree with. His job is not just political stability and security matters, which they are not doing well either. But part of the duties and responsibilities of the President in our system includes the preservation and protection of the democratic order and the democratic system.”

items.author: efosataiwo@vanguardngr.com
items.content:
The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Apple iPhone Duo are now competing for the attention of consumers looking for a premium foldable smartphone, with both devices offering large displays, powerful processors and high-end features.
Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Apple’s first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, take different approaches to the foldable phone experience.
While Samsung has several years of experience making foldable smartphones, Apple is entering the market with a device designed to combine the iPhone experience with a larger, tablet-like display.
Here’s how the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra compares with the iPhone Duo.
Display
The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra has a larger 8-inch internal AMOLED display and a 6.5-inch cover screen.
The iPhone Duo features a 7.6-inch internal OLED display and a smaller 5.4-inch external display.
Samsung therefore has the advantage for users who want as much screen space as possible when the phone is unfolded.
The larger display is particularly useful for browsing, watching videos, editing documents and running multiple applications simultaneously.
Performance
The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy processor.
Apple’s iPhone Duo runs on the company’s latest A20 Pro chip.
Both processors are designed for demanding applications, gaming and artificial intelligence features.
However, direct performance comparisons will require independent benchmark and real-world testing before a clear winner can be declared.
Camera
Samsung has the more versatile camera setup.
The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra features a 200MP main camera, a 50MP ultrawide camera and a 10MP telephoto camera with 3x optical zoom.
The iPhone Duo, meanwhile, uses two 48MP rear cameras.
Although camera quality cannot be judged by megapixel counts alone, Samsung’s dedicated telephoto camera gives the Fold 8 Ultra an advantage for users who regularly photograph distant subjects.
Apple, however, has a long-standing reputation for computational photography and video recording, meaning the iPhone Duo could still compete strongly despite having fewer cameras.
Battery
Samsung equips the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra with a 5,000mAh battery.
Apple uses a dual-cell battery design in the iPhone Duo and has focused on delivering all-day battery life despite the phone’s thin foldable design.
On paper, Samsung has the advantage in battery capacity, but actual battery performance will depend on factors including software optimisation, display usage and processor efficiency.
Multitasking and productivity
This is one area where the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra has a major advantage.
Samsung has spent years developing its foldable software, allowing users to run multiple applications on the large internal display.
The Fold 8 Ultra can effectively function as a small tablet when unfolded, making it particularly useful for people who work from their phones.
Apple has also introduced software features designed specifically for the larger display of the iPhone Duo, but Samsung’s experience gives it an advantage in foldable multitasking.
Durability
The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra has an IP48 rating.
The iPhone Duo has a higher IP68 rating, giving Apple’s device an advantage in water and dust resistance.
Durability remains an important consideration for foldable phones because their flexible displays and hinges are more complicated than those found on conventional smartphones.
Price
The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra starts at around $2,100, while Apple’s iPhone Duo starts at $1,999.
That makes Apple’s first foldable iPhone slightly cheaper at launch.
However, prices in markets such as Nigeria can differ considerably from US launch prices because of taxes, import costs, exchange rates and retailer margins.
Which one should you buy?
The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is the stronger choice for users who prioritise productivity, multitasking, camera versatility and a large internal display.
Samsung’s experience in the foldable market also means buyers are getting a more mature foldable platform.
The iPhone Duo, on the other hand, is likely to appeal most to existing Apple users who want a foldable phone without leaving the iOS ecosystem.
For users with a MacBook, Apple Watch, AirPods and other Apple devices, the iPhone Duo offers the convenience of keeping everything within Apple’s ecosystem.

items.author: Mohammed I. Yaba
items.content:
A Moroccan woman, Khadija Diob, has denied claims that she was detained or restricted while in Nigeria, saying she has returned to Morocco where she is now safe and enjoying freedom with her family.
Diob said contrary to claims attributed to her estranged husband, Nasir, that she was detained or restricted, she was currently in good health, both physically and mentally.
She made the clarification in a video clip shared on the verified Facebook page of Kaduna-based Islamic scholar, Dr Ahmad Gumi.
“I went back to Morocco six months ago. Now I’m in Morocco with my family safely and I enjoy my freedom,” Diob said.
Makinde: Blockade of Obi’s convoy confirms APC’s desperation to Silence Opposition
Moroccan woman not with Sheikh Gumi – Lawyer
“Everything Nasir claims that I was detained and restricted are false. I was detained when living with him but now, Alhamdulillah, I’m in good health, physically and mentally.”
She also explained how she came to establish a relationship with Gumi and his family after arriving in Nigeria.
According to her, Nasir took her and her mother to visit Gumi because he regarded the Islamic scholar as someone who had helped him during a difficult period of his life.
She said Nasir described Gumi as being “like a father to him” and arranged for them to meet the scholar and his family.
Diob said during the visit, her mother entrusted her to Gumi as her guardian and representative in Nigeria because she had no other person to turn to.
“My mother entrusted me to the Sheikh and told him that he should be my guardian and representative here, that I didn’t have anyone else. If I ever needed guidance or advice, I should go to him,” she said.
She added that Nasir later encouraged her to maintain contact with Gumi’s family, particularly his wife, and attend family occasions such as Eid celebrations.
According to her, Nasir wanted her to mingle with the family so she could learn about Nigerian culture and integrate into society.
She said this relationship became important when she allegedly became critically ill and claimed that Nasir refused to take her to hospital.
“That was why when Nasir refused to take me to hospital when I was critically condition, I went to Sheikh for help because I didn’t have anyone to turn to other than the Sheikh,” she said.
Diob further alleged that Gumi intervened several times to mediate between her and Nasir and offered financial assistance to help them purchase items they lacked in their home in an effort to save their marriage.
She said she eventually decided to file for divorce through her lawyer, Barrister Bilkisu, on grounds of alleged harm.
The Moroccan woman also accused Nasir of presenting a false picture of his lifestyle and financial situation before their marriage.
“As for what happened after my mother left, the defendant Nasir lies about everything. He faked his whole lifestyle, he faked his financial status, he faked all his realities to me,” she alleged.
Diob said one of the conditions she agreed with Nasir before their marriage was to have separate accommodation from his first wife.
She claimed that when she arrived in Nigeria, Nasir had not prepared the accommodation, forcing her to stay in a hotel with her mother for two weeks.
She said although he later rented a house, it lacked basic household items.
Diob thanked Gumi and his family for supporting her during her stay in Nigeria and apologised for the controversy surrounding them.
“I thanked Sheikh and his family for hosting me in Nigeria and I apologised for putting them in this condition as they are now the talk of the town just for helping me,” she said.

items.author: Abdulyassar Abdulhamid
items.content:
Kano State Governor, Abba Kabir Yusuf, has warned political parties and their supporters against hate speech, provocation, intimidation and violence as the 2027 governorship campaign officially begins.
Yusuf, through his Director General, Media and Publicity, Sunusi Bature Dawakin Tofa, gave the warning during a press conference marking the commencement of the 2027 governorship campaign in Kano.
The governor urged candidates and their supporters to make the campaign issue-based, saying political competition should be centred on ideas, policies, records and programmes rather than insults and character assassination.
He said, “Let us compete on the basis of ideas, policies, records and programmes rather than insults, intimidation or violence.”
Army Redeploys Generals In Fresh Shake-Up
Real Madrid overpower Inter, Haaland brace seals Manchester City win in UCL season opener
Yusuf also warned against the destruction of property and any action capable of disturbing the relative peace being enjoyed in the state.
He urged his supporters to remain disciplined, respect opposing views and refuse to be provoked into actions capable of undermining public order.
The governor equally charged media influencers, bloggers, conventional media practitioners and social media users to verify information before publication and avoid spreading fake news, rumours, inflammatory content and misinformation.
He called on security agencies to remain professional, impartial and vigilant throughout the campaign period, while urging political parties and campaign organisations to cooperate with them and comply with lawful requirements.
Yusuf assured residents that his administration would continue to provide services and pursue development irrespective of the political season.
He said Kano was bigger than any political party or individual, stressing that politicians would remain together as citizens after the election.
“Let us campaign with respect, compete with ideas, disagree without violence and put the interest of Kano above political differences,” he said.
The governor, however, concluded by praying for victory for APC candidates in the 2027 elections.

items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
The annual Global Fintech Festival 2026 kicked off on a glitzy note yesterday. As usual, the first day saw Indian fintech startups, from BharatPe to PhonePe, unveil a plethora of new launches and products for consumers and merchants.
Moving beyond payments, the day saw a wave of fresh product launches by startups and NPCI around AI, credit, fraud prevention and embedded financial services. Here are the prominent announcements that caught our attention…
BharatPe Rolls Out An Agentic AI Tool For Merchants
As AI continues to disrupt the status quo, BharatPe announced the launch of an agentic AI platform, specifically catering to merchants and businesses.
Built on Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, the new offering brings an AI assistant directly into BharatPe’s business app. The tool can understand the merchant’s business, products and interaction history, allowing them to communicate in their preferred language and take action across more than 60 live systems in real time.
Additionally, it also unveiled Credit Coach, which leverages AI to increase credit awareness amongst users. The platform generates personalised videos, featuring a digital avatar of former Indian cricketer Rohit Sharma.
Jio Payment Solutions Unveils Cross-Border Payment Service
Financial services giant Jio Financial Services’ (JFS) subsidiary has partnered with US-based Citi to launch a cross-border payments service. Under this, it will enable domestic businesses to accept international payments from customers worldwide.
In a post on LinkedIn, JFS said that the service is designed to make international payments more seamless, efficient and cost-effective, with ambitions to reduce turnaround time and offer greater convenience for Indians across borders.
Pine Labs Launches Agentic Commerce Stack
The listed fintech major has partnered with L&T Finance to introduce an agentic commerce feature on the latter’s PLANET app. The agentic commerce feature allows AI agents to carry out transactions on behalf of users within predefined controls.
The integration uses Pine Labs Payments Protocol (P3P) and the Grantex protocol to enable communication between AI agents and facilitate controlled transaction execution.
The offering will initially focus on flight ticket bookings. Under the proposed setup, an AI agent can act on a user’s stated intent and complete the booking process within the app, subject to user-defined parameters or “guardrails”.
Amazon Pay’s New Credit Card For Small Merchants
Amazon Pay has joined hands with Kotak Mahindra Bank to launch co-branded credit cards for small business owners. The credit cards will be limited to merchants on Amazon Business, the company’s dedicated B2B ecommerce marketplace.
The ecommerce giant said that the credit card will combine cashback on business expenses with an interest-free credit period, giving small businesses flexibility to manage their purchase payments. The card will also provide offers on AWS credits, covering services such as cloud computing, data storage and AI.
Yubi Debuts New Lending Platform For Retail Borrowers
Fintech giant Yubi has launched Pye, a new lending platform built for retail borrowers. The service will enable retail borrowers to connect with lending institutions through a single integration.
Pye is designed to cater to everyday credit needs, such as weddings, home and education expenses, and medical emergencies. Rather than routing a borrower’s application to a single lender, the platform connects it with a network of lending partners and matches the borrower with the creditor best suited to their profile, loan requirement and timeline.
Besides this, it also unveiled a consumer credit-health app called TopScore, where users can access their credit score and view the information in simplified language across 10 languages.

items.author: Aasil Ahmed
items.content:
Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone. The new model uses a book-style design that opens to reveal a large 7.6-inch display while retaining a smaller screen for use when the phone is closed.
The Duo is designed to work as both a conventional smartphone and a larger multitasking device. When unfolded, users can run apps side by side and use the larger screen for tasks such as video, gaming, and document work. Apple also supports Apple Pencil input on the foldable for the first time on an iPhone.
Design and Display
The iPhone Duo uses a short and wide, passport-style design. When closed, it has a 5.4-inch outer display. Opening the phone reveals a 7.6-inch inner display, which Apple describes as the largest display ever used on an iPhone.
The inner display gives the Duo a much larger workspace than a conventional iPhone. Apple supports side-by-side apps and other multitasking features on the larger screen.
Both displays support ProMotion with refresh rates of up to 120Hz. The inner screen uses a custom surface designed to reduce the appearance of the fold when the phone is opened. Apple also uses a scratch-resistant coating on the display.
The phone uses a titanium structure reinforced with ceramic fibers and second-generation Ceramic Shield protection. It also has an IP68 rating for water and dust resistance.
Apple offers the Duo in Star White and Night Sky finishes.
Face ID is not used on the foldable. Instead, Apple has placed Touch ID on the side of the device, allowing the authentication hardware to fit into the thinner foldable design.
Internals and Software
The iPhone Duo is powered by Apple’s A20 Pro chip, built using a 2-nanometer process. The chip has a six-core CPU and seven-core GPU, with a 32-core Neural Engine for AI processing.
The phone also uses Apple’s C2 modem for cellular connectivity.
The Duo runs iOS 27, with Apple’s software adapted for its two-screen form factor. The larger internal display allows multiple apps to run side by side, while the system can transition between the outer and inner screens as the phone is opened and closed.
The device includes USB-C connectivity, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and NFC. It also supports MagSafe wireless charging.
AI Features
The iPhone Duo supports Apple’s Apple Intelligence features through iOS 27.
The A20 Pro’s Neural Engine handles AI processing on the device, while Apple’s broader Apple Intelligence system also uses Private Cloud Compute for requests that require additional processing.
The Duo also gets the new AI capabilities introduced with iOS 27, including the updated Siri experience, AI-assisted image editing and other Apple Intelligence tools.
The foldable form factor adds another use for these features. The larger internal screen gives AI-generated content, image editing, and multitasking tools more space to display information and controls.
Cameras
The iPhone Duo has a dual 48MP rear camera system. Unlike the iPhone 18 Pro models, the foldable does not have a third dedicated telephoto camera.
The phone also has a front-facing camera for video calls. The inner display uses an under-display camera, allowing Apple to avoid placing a visible camera cutout in the larger screen.
 
The rear cameras can also be used when the phone is unfolded, allowing the large internal display to act as a viewfinder.
Apple has focused the Duo’s camera system on fitting two high-resolution cameras into a thinner foldable body rather than matching the three-camera system used by its Pro iPhones.
Battery and Pricing
The Duo uses two battery cells, with the batteries split between the two halves of the foldable body.
Apple rates the phone for up to 44 hours of use when relying on the outer display. Video playback on the larger internal screen is rated at up to 31 hours.
The dual-battery arrangement allows Apple to use the available space on both sides of the foldable while keeping the device thin.
The iPhone Duo also supports wireless charging through MagSafe.
The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999 with 256GB of storage.
Apple also offers higher-capacity versions, including a 2TB configuration that costs around $3,000.

items.author: Peter Moses
items.content:
The 2027 governorship candidate of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) in Ogun State, Oladipupo Adebutu, has formally flagged off his campaign, promising to “liberate” the state from poverty, insecurity, unemployment and what he described as poor governance.
Adebutu unveiled his campaign agenda, tagged “ITURA DE”, meaning relief or liberation, on Wednesday, at the Ake Palace in Abeokuta, where he presented his address titled: “A Call to Liberation”.
The former federal lawmaker said the agenda would form the blueprint of his administration if elected, with a focus on restoring local government autonomy, improving workers’ welfare, reviving the economy and expanding access to social services.
According to Adebutu, the ITURA DE agenda is built around seven priority areas: improved security, law and order; local government financial autonomy and workers’ welfare; urban and regional development, physical planning and transportation; rural and border communities development; agricultural, economic and industrial development; development of women, youth and sports; and enhancement of education, healthcare and other social services.
He said the programmes would be anchored on strategic infrastructure development, entrepreneurship, economic resilience, functional communities, and accountability and transparency in governance.
Adebutu pledged to strengthen security across farms, highways and communities, while guaranteeing citizens the freedom to associate politically without fear of victimisation.
“With ITURA DE programmes, the seven cardinal pillars are designed to systematically eradicate entrenched poverty and restore power to the good people of Ogun State,” he said.
“We shall dismantle the architecture of fear, aggressively securing every farm, highway, and neighbourhood from lawlessness and also guarantee total freedom of choice of political leaning as a dividend of true democracy.”
The PDP candidate also promised to restore what he described as genuine financial autonomy to local governments, arguing that stronger councils would create additional centres of development across the state.
Workers’ welfare, he added, would be a major priority of his administration. He pledged to address outstanding pensions and gratuities and review the Contributory Pension Scheme.
On the economy, he said his administration would prioritise agriculture, vocational training, entrepreneurship and easier access to finance for farmers and young people. He promised zero-interest loans and other interventions to make farming more profitable.
He also pledged to review what he described as “predatory structures of double taxation” affecting traders and small business owners, while restructuring government policies to improve the ease of doing business.
At the campaign launch, the PDP deputy governorship candidate, Alhaja Yemi Showunmi-Kolapo, also called on Ogun residents to support the party, saying an Adebutu-led government would bring relief from poverty and what she described as maladministration.
Showunmi-Kolapo said supporters had demonstrated their commitment by attending the campaign despite the rain, arguing that it was Adebutu’s turn to govern the state.
“I want to assure you all that in Ogun State, there is freedom, relief is here. (ITURA DE). The last time we flagged off the National Assembly campaign, it rain and we moved in the rain.”
“Today as well, we are flagging off our governorship campaign, it rained and we moved in it. Don’t let them deceive you, we will gather like this during the inauguration of Hon. Ladi Adebutu as governor. Egba people, stand by your own.
“Former governors Ibikunle Amosun, Osoba Gbenga Daniel have governed Ogun, among others. The Adebutu family has been supporting and empowering the people of Ogun State. We want to tell the governor (Dapo Abiodun) that he should release the governorship seat, it’s Adebutu’s turn,” she said.
The Ogun PDP chairman, Abayomi Tella, similarly urged the electorate to vote for Adebutu, promising that the party would reciprocate the support with improved social amenities and good governance.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max Launch With New Cameras and Higher Prices
items.summary:

Apple has also launched new Apple Watches and an all-new foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, which will be covered in a separate article.

One of the most visible changes is the smaller Dynamic Island. Apple has redesigned it to occupy less space while allowing it to display up to three Live Activities at the same time. Face ID remains integrated into the system for authent
items.author: Aasil Ahmed
items.content:
Apple has launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max with a new variable-aperture main camera, the A20 Pro chip, a redesigned Dynamic Island, longer battery life, and new AI capabilities.
The two Pro models also bring Apple’s new C2 cellular modem and N1 wireless networking chip. Both phones run iOS 27 and introduce a new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence.
Apple has also launched new Apple Watches and an all-new foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, which will be covered in a separate article.
Design and Display
The iPhone 18 Pro has a 6.3-inch display, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max uses a larger 6.9-inch panel. Both retain Apple’s Super Retina XDR OLED display technology and ProMotion, with adaptive refresh rates reaching 120Hz.
One of the most visible changes is the smaller Dynamic Island. Apple has redesigned it to occupy less space while allowing it to display up to three Live Activities at the same time. Face ID remains integrated into the system for authentication and unlocking.
Apple is offering both phones in four finishes: black, silver, glacier, and the new burgundy color.
The phones also use a new vapor chamber for thermal management. Apple says the redesigned system has three times more surface area than the previous-generation iPhone 17 Pro and can enable up to a 40 percent improvement in sustained performance.
Internals and Software
Both phones are powered by Apple’s new A20 Pro chip. It is built using a 2-nanometer manufacturing process and includes a six-core CPU, seven-core GPU and a dual 16-core Neural Engine.
Apple says the A20 Pro provides 50 percent more memory bandwidth than the A19 Pro. Its GPU can deliver up to 40 percent higher performance than the previous generation, while the Neural Engine provides twice the AI processing power.
Wireless connectivity is handled by Apple’s N1 chip, which supports Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread.
The phones also introduce Apple’s C2 cellular modem. Apple says it provides faster uploads than the previous C1X modem while using 15 percent less energy. The C2 also supports mmWave connectivity in the U.S.
Both models ship with iOS 27. The software also introduces iPhone Handoff, allowing users with supported carriers to switch between two iPhones while keeping the same phone number.
AI Features
The iPhone 18 Pro models introduce the next generation of Apple Intelligence alongside a new Siri AI experience. This was already announced in June, but it is now making its debut with the new iPhone 18 family.
Siri AI is available as a beta feature with iOS 27. It can use personal context from information such as messages, emails, and photos to provide more relevant responses. It can also understand what is displayed on the screen and take actions based on that information.
A new Siri mode in the Camera app can identify and provide information about objects and scenes in front of the camera.
Apple Intelligence also adds new image-editing capabilities. Users can use Spatial Reframing and Extend to change the composition of images, while an upgraded Clean Up tool can remove unwanted elements.
Image Playground can now generate photorealistic images, while Safari gains Notify Me for tracking changes to webpages.
Apple says its AI processing uses a combination of on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute.
Cameras
The biggest camera change is the new 48MP Fusion Main camera. For the first time on an iPhone, the main camera has a variable aperture.
The lens uses six laser-cut blades that adjust the aperture according to lighting and depth-of-field requirements. It can automatically widen the aperture to ƒ/1.48 for low-light photography, use ƒ/1.8 for portraits, or narrow it to ƒ/4 to keep more subjects in focus. Users can also manually select among four aperture settings.
Apple has also introduced a new computational photography pipeline for the main camera. The company says it improves detail and image quality, particularly in low-light conditions and group photos.
The Camera app now includes Pro controls that provide manual control over aperture, shutter speed, and white balance. Users can also display a histogram to monitor exposure.
Photographic Styles gains new texture and grain controls, giving users more control over the appearance of photos.
Video recording also gets new options. Cinematic effects can now be applied after recording to video captured at up to 60 frames per second. Time-lapse recording supports 4K and Dolby Vision HDR.
Audio Mix has also been updated with algorithms designed to improve voice quality and isolate music.
Another new camera feature is Apple Reference Image. The system can create an unalterable reference image based on signed sensor data captured when a photograph is taken. The reference image can then be compared with the edited version in the Photos app to help determine whether changes were made.
Battery and Pricing
Battery life is another major upgrade. Apple says eSIM-only versions can provide up to 36 hours of video playback on the iPhone 18 Pro and up to 45 hours on the iPhone 18 Pro Max.
The iPhone 18 Pro can charge to 50 percent in around 15 minutes using wired charging. Wireless charging can reach 50 percent in about 30 minutes.
The iPhone 18 Pro Max can provide around seven hours of video playback after five minutes of wired charging. Apple also says its new battery usage model indicates up to 30 hours of usage on a full charge.
The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 for 256GB, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299 for 256GB. Both models are available with 512GB, 1TB, and 2TB of storage.
The $1,199 starting price represents a $100 increase over the previous-generation iPhone 17 Pro, while the Pro Max also costs $100 more at the entry level.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Apple resmi memperkenalkan Apple Watch Series 12 sebagai generasi terbaru smartwatch yang membawa sejumlah peningkatan pada pemantauan kesehatan, fitness, hingga fitur berbasis Apple Intelligence. Salah satu perubahan utamanya terletak pada Health Sensing System baru yang dipadukan dengan chip S11, termasuk pengukuran detak jantung dan heart rate variability (HRV) dengan frekuensi lebih tinggi.
Apple juga memperkenalkan fitur Readiness yang memberikan skor 0–10 berdasarkan aktivitas, beban latihan, data kesehatan, dan kualitas tidur pengguna. Fitur ini dirancang untuk membantu menentukan apakah tubuh siap beraktivitas atau justru membutuhkan pemulihan. Meski begitu, skor tersebut tetap merupakan hasil analisis algoritma dan bukan pengganti penilaian medis.
Di sisi lain, Series 12 mulai membawa kemampuan AI yang lebih jauh melalui watchOS 27. Siri AI kini dapat memahami konteks personal dan mengakses pengetahuan umum langsung dari pergelangan tangan. Apple juga menambahkan sejumlah fitur Audio Intelligence untuk membantu pengguna mengingat percakapan atau mengenali suara penting di sekitar.
Baca Juga: Apple Watch Ultra 4 Bawa Health Sensing System Baru hingga Siri AI
Sensor Kesehatan Lebih Sering Membaca Data
Apple Watch Series 12 menggunakan sistem sensor optik dan elektrik baru untuk melakukan pemantauan kesehatan secara lebih rutin. Sensor optiknya kini mengukur detak jantung setiap lima detik sepanjang hari, sementara pengukuran HRV dapat dilakukan hingga 24 kali lebih sering dibanding generasi sebelumnya.
Data tersebut digunakan untuk memberikan gambaran mengenai kondisi tubuh, termasuk melalui Overnight Vitals dan tampilan metrik kesehatan pada siang hari. Apple mengklaim sistem baru ini menghasilkan akurasi detak jantung tertinggi dibanding sejumlah wearable lain dalam studi yang melibatkan lebih dari 1.000 peserta. Namun, klaim tersebut tetap berasal dari pengujian yang dilakukan Apple, sehingga belum tentu menggambarkan semua kondisi penggunaan sehari-hari.
Selain sensor, Apple Watch Series 12 juga membawa pembaruan pada sistem penghitung langkah dengan algoritma machine learning baru. Apple mengklaim akurasinya menjadi yang tertinggi di antara smartwatch, sementara baterainya tetap mencapai 24 jam untuk penggunaan sehari-hari dan hingga 10 jam saat outdoor workout.
Siri AI dan Audio Intelligence Hadir di Pergelangan Tangan
watchOS 27 membawa Siri AI ke Apple Watch Series 12. Melalui aplikasi Siri baru, pengguna dapat melanjutkan percakapan, memanfaatkan pemahaman konteks personal, serta mendapatkan informasi dari pengetahuan umum. Siri AI sendiri masih berstatus beta dan peluncurannya dilakukan bertahap berdasarkan bahasa dan wilayah.
Apple juga memperkenalkan Audio Intelligence, termasuk Live Rewind untuk menampilkan kembali 15 detik percakapan dalam bentuk teks dan Siri Recap yang membuat rangkuman singkat percakapan. Ada pula Sound Recognition dan integrasi Shazam. Apple menyebut pemrosesan audio dirancang tanpa menyimpan rekaman suara mentah, dengan Secure Exclave pada chip S11 untuk menangani pemrosesan secara terisolasi.
Apple Watch Series 12 tersedia dalam ukuran 42mm dan 46mm, dengan pilihan material aluminium, titanium, hingga keramik. Harganya mulai US$399 dan mulai tersedia pada 18 September. watchOS 27 sendiri akan tersedia pada 14 September untuk perangkat yang kompatibel, meski tidak semua fitur tersedia di setiap model, bahasa, dan wilayah.

items.content:
Akhirnya Apple resmi menghadirkan smartphone lipat alias foldable perdananya, dan siap bersaing dengan kompetitor lain seperti Samsung hingga HUAWEI yang sudah merilis sekian generasi sebelumnya. Melalui iPhone Duo, Apple memilih untuk hadirkan foldable pertamanya dalam desain lebih ringkas. Memanfaatkan material yang dirancang kuat, serta sematkan dua sensor kamera di sisi belakang.
Desain iPhone Fold sendiri memang sudah bocor sejak beberapa bulan terakhir, namun setidaknya kini Apple memiliki kesempatan untuk menjelaskan keunggulan pada aspek tersebut, mulai dari pemilihan material, dimensi, hingga layar utamanya yang dibuat spesial. Secara tampilan, tentunya iPhone Duo akan cukup banyak dibandingkan dengan Galaxy Z Fold8 yang memiliki dimensi dan rasio layar mendekati atau serupa.
Menjadi generasi pertama, tentunya iPhone Duo akan sangat menggoda terutama untuk para penggemar produk Apple. Sementara bagi mereka yang lebih “konservatif”, bisa memilih iPhone 18 Pro Series yang notabene merupakan wujud penyempurnaan dari beberapa generasi sebelumnya. Apakah iPhone Duo dirancang sebagai perangkat pendukung produktivitas? Mari kita bedah keunggulannya satu persatu.
Baca juga: iPhone 18 Pro Series Punya Dynamic Island Baru dan Kamera dengan Variable Aperture
Apple Pastikan Layar iPhone Duo Mulus, Pakai Nano-Texture
Dalam memperkenalkan iPhone Duo, Apple lebih banyak menghabiskan waktu untuk membahas aspek desain, termasuk mekanisme lipat, dimensi perangkat yang dipilih, dan teknologi layar yang diusungnya. Rasio layar luar dan dalam dibuat sama agar transisi antar layar terasa lebih mulus. Sementara di dalam, Apple gunakan teknologi kamera under-display, mirip seperti Galaxy Z Fold terdahulu.
iOS 27 dengan Liquid Glass juga berperan penting, karena tampilan antarmuka iPhone Duo dibuat lebih adaptif, termasuk mendukung opsi split screen, alias menjalankan dua aplikasi sekaligus. Layar iPhone Duo berukuran cukup kompak di sisi luar yakni 5,4 inci atau sekitar 90% area layar iPhone 18 Pro, sementara ketika dibuka, berukuran 7,6 inci. Menariknya, Apple siap hadirkan dukungan Apple Pencil ke kedua layar iPhone Duo ke depannya.
Menariknya, Apple juga hadirnya opsi nano-texture pada layar utama iPhone Duo, diturunkan dari lini Mac maupun iPad. Apple memastikan bila hinge dapat terbuka lebih mulus, dengan layar utamanya yang sepenuhnya datar. Dan seperti rumor sebelumnya, iPhone Duo hadir dengan Touch ID, alias bukan Face ID. Tersedia dalam warna putih dan biru gelap, bodinya dirancang kuat, memanfaatkan material titanium, membawa sertifikasi IP68, serta proteksi Ceramic Shield (versi dua di depan) pada kedua sisi perangkat.
iPhone Duo disebutkan memiliki hinge alias mekanisme lipat yang membawa lebih dari 100 komponen, termasuk material carbon fiber. Apple merancang cip A20 Pro agar lebih efisien, memanfaatkan teknologi fabrikasi 2nm. Dengan sistem pendinginan yang juga dirancang superior, iPhone Duo bahkan diklaim bisa berikan performa maksimalnya hingga 30% lebih lama dibandingkan iPhone 17 Pro.
Punya Dua Kamera, Baterai Diklaim Tahan Lama
Mengingat dimensi iPhone Duo tergolong cukup kompak, membuat Apple hanya sematkan dua sensor kamera di sisi belakang perangkat, yakni sensor wide 48MP serta ultra-wide. Ya, setidaknya jumlahnya lebih banyak dibandingkan iPhone Air, dan Apple kembali menyiasati absennya sensor telefoto khusus dengan menawarkan fitur lossless zoom—atau yang Apple sebut “optical-quality zoom”.
Sensor ultra-wide 48MP pada kamera iPhone Duo diklaim sama dengan milik iPhone 18 Pro, dan pengguna bisa memanfaatkan mode lipat layar seperti 90 derajat untuk perekaman yang lebih mudah, tanpa bantuan tripod. Tentunya, selain menggunakan kamera selfie 12MP Center Stage di sisi luar, mode selfie dengan kamera utama (plus opsi previu layar luar) juga tersedia
Plus, memanfaatkan kemampuan pengenalan pose, kamera iPhone Duo mampu menangkap pose atau momen hingga ekspresi secara otomatis, sehingga pengguna tidak perlu menekan tombol shutter, yang Apple sebut dengan Smart Take.
Dalam bodinya yang kompak nan tipis, tentu aspek daya tahan baterai bakal menjadi salah satu pertanyaan utama. Kabar baiknya, daya tahan baterai iPhone Duo sendiri diklaim tetap bisa digunakan hingga seharian penuh—tentunya perlu dibuktikan secara langsung dalam skenario penggunaan yang berbeda-beda.
Sementara klaim Apple sendiri, iPhone Duo mampu memutar video hingga 31 jam saat menggunakan layar utama, atau 44 jam dengan layar luar. Dan teknologi fast charging pada iPhone Duo mampu menambah daya sampai 50% dalam 20 menit.
Harga iPhone Duo dibanderol mulai USD1999 atau sekitar Rp35 juta, untuk kapasitas penyimpanan mulai 256GB. Berbeda dengan iPhone 18 Pro, ketersediaan iPhone Duo dimulai Oktober mendatang. Kira-kira berapa harga yang pas ketika hadir resmi di Indonesia?

items.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4 Bawa Health Sensing System Baru hingga Siri AI
items.summary:
Apple resmi memperkenalkan Apple Watch Ultra 4 sebagai smartwatch terbarunya untuk pengguna yang aktif berolahraga maupun melakukan aktivitas outdoor. Generasi ini membawa sejumlah pembaruan pada sistem pemantauan kesehatan, performa GPS, serta daya tahan baterai. Apple juga memperkenalkan Health Sensing System dan chip S11 yang menjadi fondasi sejumlah fitur baru pada perangkat tersebut.
Salah satu peningkatan yang mendapat perhatian adalah kemampuan pemantauan detak jantung yang diklaim Apple sebagai yang paling akurat di kategori wearable. Apple Watch Ultra 4 kini melakukan pengukuran detak jantung secara pasif setiap lima detik sepanjang hari, sementara pengukuran Heart Rate Variability (HRV) dilakukan hingga 24 kali lebih sering dibandingkan sebelumnya. Data tersebut kemudian digunakan untuk memberikan gambaran kondisi tubuh pengguna.
Apple juga memperkenalkan fitur Readiness yang memberikan skor 0–10 berdasarkan kombinasi aktivitas, beban latihan, tidur, dan data vital pengguna.
items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Apple resmi memperkenalkan Apple Watch Ultra 4 sebagai smartwatch terbarunya untuk pengguna yang aktif berolahraga maupun melakukan aktivitas outdoor. Generasi ini membawa sejumlah pembaruan pada sistem pemantauan kesehatan, performa GPS, serta daya tahan baterai. Apple juga memperkenalkan Health Sensing System dan chip S11 yang menjadi fondasi sejumlah fitur baru pada perangkat tersebut.
Salah satu peningkatan yang mendapat perhatian adalah kemampuan pemantauan detak jantung yang diklaim Apple sebagai yang paling akurat di kategori wearable. Apple Watch Ultra 4 kini melakukan pengukuran detak jantung secara pasif setiap lima detik sepanjang hari, sementara pengukuran Heart Rate Variability (HRV) dilakukan hingga 24 kali lebih sering dibandingkan sebelumnya. Data tersebut kemudian digunakan untuk memberikan gambaran kondisi tubuh pengguna.
Apple juga memperkenalkan fitur Readiness yang memberikan skor 0–10 berdasarkan kombinasi aktivitas, beban latihan, tidur, dan data vital pengguna. Fitur ini ditujukan untuk membantu menentukan apakah tubuh siap beraktivitas atau membutuhkan pemulihan. Meski demikian, skor tersebut tetap merupakan interpretasi berbasis algoritma dan bukan pengganti penilaian medis maupun kondisi fisik pengguna secara langsung.
Baca Juga: iPhone 18 Pro Series Punya Dynamic Island Baru dan Kamera dengan Variable Aperture
Pemantauan Kesehatan dan Baterai Lebih Panjang
Apple Watch Ultra 4 menawarkan daya tahan baterai hingga 50 jam untuk penggunaan sehari-hari dan hingga 84 jam dalam Low Power Mode. Untuk aktivitas outdoor, Extended Workout Mode dapat digunakan hingga 25 jam dengan GPS dan pemantauan detak jantung aktif. Sementara Max Extended Workout Mode memungkinkan pelacakan hingga 45 jam dengan GPS yang tetap mengambil data setiap detik.
Peningkatan lainnya hadir melalui aplikasi Health yang akan mendapatkan desain baru akhir tahun ini. Apple menambahkan tab Longevity dengan fitur Health Age untuk membandingkan sejumlah metrik kesehatan dengan usia pengguna. Namun, sejumlah fitur kesehatan baru tersebut tidak langsung tersedia saat peluncuran dan beberapa di antaranya memiliki keterbatasan wilayah.
Siri AI dan Fitur Audio Intelligence
Apple Watch Ultra 4 juga menjadi bagian dari ekspansi Apple Intelligence melalui watchOS 27. Siri AI dapat memahami konteks pribadi dan memberikan informasi berbasis pengetahuan umum, sementara aplikasi Siri memungkinkan pengguna melanjutkan percakapan langsung dari pergelangan tangan. Siri AI sendiri akan tersedia sebagai beta mulai 14 September dan pada awalnya mendukung bahasa Inggris.
Chip S11 juga memungkinkan fitur Audio Intelligence seperti Live Rewind untuk mengingat kembali 15 detik percakapan dan Siri Recap yang merangkum percakapan. Ada pula Sound Recognition untuk mengenali suara seperti alarm dan sirene. Apple mengatakan pemrosesan audio dirancang dengan Secure Exclave dan tidak menyimpan rekaman audio mentah.
Meski membawa cukup banyak fitur baru, Apple Watch Ultra 4 tetap membutuhkan perangkat dan software yang kompatibel untuk memanfaatkan kemampuan AI secara penuh. Siri AI dan sejumlah fitur Audio Intelligence juga masih berstatus beta atau baru akan tersedia kemudian. Apple Watch Ultra 4 dibanderol mulai US$799 dan mulai tersedia pada 18 September 2026.
